title.zh: 卷四十五 本紀第四十五: 順帝八
title.raw: 卷四十五 本紀第四十五: 順帝八 Volume 45 Annals 45: Shundi 8

sentences.zh: 順帝八

translations.literal: Shundi 8
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 8

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月丙子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, spring, first month, bingzi new moon; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the new moon of bingzi in the first month of spring, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以伯顏禿古思為大司徒。

translations.literal: Bayan Toghus was made grand preceptor of state.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan Toghus was appointed grand preceptor of state.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命山東分省團結義兵，每州添設判官一員，每縣添設主簿一員，專率義兵以事守禦，仍命各路達魯花赤提調，聽宣慰使司節制。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the Shandong Branch Secretariat was ordered to muster righteous militia; each prefecture was to add one assistant prefect, each county one registrar, charged solely with leading righteous militia for defense; the darughachi of each circuit were still ordered to supervise them, subject to the control of the pacification commissioner's office.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the Shandong branch secretariat was ordered to muster righteous militia; each prefecture was to add one assistant prefect and each county one registrar, charged solely with leading righteous militia for defense, while the darughachi of each circuit were to supervise them under the pacification commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 丙申，監察御史哈剌章言：「淮東道廉訪使褚不華，徇忠盡節，宜加褒贈，優恤其家。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, investigating censor Hala Zhang said: "Chu Buhua, surveillance commissioner of the Huaidong Circuit, devoted himself in loyalty to the utmost; he should receive posthumous honors and his family should receive generous relief."
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, investigating censor Hala Zhang said: "Chu Buhua, surveillance commissioner of the Huaidong circuit, gave his life in loyal service; he should receive posthumous honors, and his family should receive generous relief."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，賊犯七盤、藍田，命察罕帖木兒以軍會答兒麻亦兒守陜州、潼關；

translations.literal: Second month, renzi day; bandits attacked Qipan and Lantian; Chaghan Temür was ordered to lead troops to join Darmaghayir in defending Shaanzhou and Tong Pass;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renzi day, rebels attacked Qipan and Lantian; Chaghan Temür was ordered to lead troops to join Darmaghayir in defending Shaanzhou and Tong Pass;

sentences.zh: 哈剌不花由潼關抵陜西，會豫王阿剌忒納失裏及定住等同進討。

translations.literal: Qara Buqa advanced from Tong Pass into Shaanxi and joined Prince Yu Ala Temür and Dingzhu and others in a joint punitive advance.
translations.idiomatic: Qara Buqa advanced from Tong Pass into Shaanxi and joined Prince Yu Ala Temür, Dingzhu, and others in a joint punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰犯五車。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the moon transgressed the Five Chariots constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the moon transgressed the Five Chariots constellation.

sentences.zh: 以征河南許、亳、太康、嵩、汝大捷，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Because of the great victory in the campaign against Xu, Bo, Taikang, Song, and Ru in Henan, an edict granted a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the great victory in the campaign against Xu, Bo, Taikang, Song, and Ru in Henan, an edict granted a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，知樞密院事脫脫復邳州，調客省使撒兒答溫等攻黃河南岸賊，大破之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Toghto, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, recovered Pizhou; the guest-reception commissioner Sar Dawin and others were dispatched to attack bandits on the south bank of the Yellow River and inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Toghto, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, recovered Pizhou and dispatched the guest-reception commissioner Sar Dawin and others to attack rebels on the south bank of the Yellow River, inflicting a great defeat on them.

sentences.zh: 壬申，劉福通遣其黨毛貴陷膠州，僉樞密院事脫歡死之。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Liu Futong sent his follower Mao Gui, who captured Jiaozhou; Toqon, associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Liu Futong sent his follower Mao Gui, who captured Jiaozhou; Toqon, associate commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, was killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，倪文俊陷峽州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Ni Wenjun captured Xiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Ni Wenjun captured Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，李武、崔德陷商州，察罕帖木兒與李思齊以兵自陜、虢援陜西，以察罕帖木兒為陜西行省左丞，李思齊為四川行省左丞。

translations.literal: That month, Li Wu and Cui De captured Shangzhou; Chaghan Temür and Li Siji led troops from Shaan and Guo to relieve Shaanxi; Chaghan Temür was made left vice director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, and Li Siji was made left vice director of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Li Wu and Cui De captured Shangzhou; Chaghan Temür and Li Siji led troops from Shaan and Guo to relieve Shaanxi; Chaghan Temür was appointed left vice director of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, and Li Siji was appointed left vice director of the Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔以高寶為四川行省參知政事，將兵取中興，不克，賊遂破轆轤關。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Gao Bao associate chief minister of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat and ordered him to lead troops to recover Zhongxing; he failed, and the bandits then broke through Lulu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Gao Bao associate chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat and ordered him to lead troops to recover Zhongxing; he failed, and the rebels then broke through Lulu Pass.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥朔，義兵萬戶賽甫丁、阿迷裏丁叛據泉州。

translations.literal: Third month, yihai new moon; the righteous-militia commanders Saif al-Din and Amir al-Din rebelled and seized Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of yihai, the righteous-militia commanders Saif al-Din and Amir al-Din rebelled and seized Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，毛貴陷萊州，守臣山東宣慰副使釋嘉訥死之。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Mao Gui captured Laizhou; the defending official, associate pacification commissioner of Shandong Shijian'a, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Mao Gui captured Laizhou; Shijian'a, associate pacification commissioner of Shandong, was killed defending the city.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大明兵取常州路。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Ming forces captured Changzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Ming forces captured Changzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，歲星犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Jupiter transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Jupiter transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 甲午，毛貴陷益都路，益王買奴遁，自是山東郡邑皆陷。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Mao Gui captured Yidu Circuit; Prince Yi Mainu fled; from this time onward all prefectures and counties of Shandong fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Mao Gui captured Yidu circuit; Prince Yi Mainu fled, and from this time onward all prefectures and counties in Shandong fell.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以江淮行樞密院副使董摶霄為山東宣慰使。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Dong Bowo, associate commissioner of the Jianghuai Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, was made pacification commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Dong Bowo, associate commissioner of the Jianghuai branch bureau of military affairs, was appointed pacification commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，毛貴陷濱州。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Mao Gui captured Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Mao Gui captured Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以中書平章政事帖裏帖木兒為御史大夫，悟良哈臺、斡欒並為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Tegel Temür, chief minister of the Secretariat, was made censor-in-chief; Ulugh Qada'i and Olon were both made chief ministers of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Tegel Temür, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief; Ulugh Qada'i and Olon were both appointed chief ministers of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，監察御史五十九言：「今京師周圍，雖設二十四營，軍卒疲弱，素不訓練，誠為虛設，儻有不測，誠可寒心。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingwu day; investigating censor Wujiu said: "Around the capital today, although twenty-four camps have been established, the soldiers are weak and have never been trained; they are truly a hollow show, and if anything unforeseen should occur, it would indeed be chilling."
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the bingwu day of the fourth month, investigating censor Wujiu said: "Around the capital today, although twenty-four camps have been established, the troops are weak and have never been drilled; they exist in name only, and if anything unforeseen should happen, it would be truly alarming."

sentences.zh: 宜速選擇驍勇精銳，衛護大駕，鎮守京師，實當今奠安根本、固堅人心之急務。

translations.literal: Brave and elite troops should quickly be selected to guard the imperial carriage, garrison the capital, and secure the realm—this is truly the urgent task of establishing the foundation and firming the people's hearts today.
translations.idiomatic: Brave elite troops should quickly be selected to guard the imperial carriage and garrison the capital; this is truly the urgent task of securing the foundation and steadying popular morale today.

sentences.zh: 況武備莫重於兵，而養兵莫先於食。

translations.literal: Moreover, in military preparedness nothing is weightier than troops, and in sustaining troops nothing comes before provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in military preparedness nothing matters more than troops, and in sustaining troops nothing comes before provisions.

sentences.zh: 今朝廷撥降鈔錠，措置農具，命總兵官於河南克復州郡，且耕且戰，甚合寓兵於農之意。

translations.literal: Now the court has allocated paper-currency ingots and arranged farm tools, ordering overall commanders in the recovered prefectures and counties of Henan to farm while fighting—this accords well with the idea of embedding soldiers among farmers.
translations.idiomatic: The court has now allocated paper-currency ingots and arranged farm tools, ordering overall commanders in the recovered prefectures and counties of Henan to farm while fighting—this accords well with the idea of embedding soldiers among farmers.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，權命總兵官從宜於軍官內選委能撫字軍民者，兼路府州縣之職，務要農事有成，軍民得所，則擾民之害亦除，而匱乏之憂亦釋矣。

translations.literal: As a measure for the present, overall commanders should provisionally be empowered to select from among military officers those able to comfort soldiers and civilians, and to hold concurrently the posts of circuit, prefecture, and county; agriculture must succeed and soldiers and civilians must find their place—then the harm of harassing the people will also be removed, and the worry of scarcity will also be eased."
translations.idiomatic: For the present, overall commanders should be empowered to select from among military officers those able to govern soldiers and civilians well and to hold concurrently circuit, prefecture, and county posts, so that agriculture may succeed and soldiers and civilians may find security; then the harm of harassing the people will be removed and the worry of scarcity relieved."

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised and adopted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and adopted the proposal.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，毛貴陷莒州。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Mao Gui captured Juzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Mao Gui captured Juzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，京師立便民六庫，倒易昏鈔。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, six convenience treasuries were established in the capital to exchange worn paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, six convenience treasuries were established in the capital to exchange worn paper currency.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以咬咬為甘肅行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Yao Yao was made left chief minister of the Gansu Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Yao Yao was appointed left chief minister of the Gansu branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 答失八都魯加太尉、四川行省左丞相。

translations.literal: Darmabala was promoted to grand commander and left chief minister of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Darmabala was promoted to grand commander and appointed left chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 漢中道廉訪司糾陜西行省左丞蕭家奴遇賊逃竄，失陷所守郡邑，詔正其罪。

translations.literal: The Hanzhong Circuit surveillance commission impeached Xiao Jianu, left vice director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, for fleeing when bandits appeared and losing the prefectures and counties he had been charged to defend; an edict ordered his punishment according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanzhong circuit surveillance commission impeached Xiao Jianu, left vice director of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, for fleeing when rebels appeared and losing the prefectures and counties he had been charged to defend; an edict ordered that he be punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 封江西行省平章政事火你赤為營國公。

translations.literal: Huo Niji, chief minister of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, was enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Niji, chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 大明兵取寧國路。

translations.literal: Ming forces captured Ningguo Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces captured Ningguo circuit.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥朔，命知樞密院事孛蘭奚進兵討山東。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yihai new moon; Bolanxi, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to advance troops to suppress Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of yihai, Bolanxi, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, was ordered to advance troops to suppress Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，平章政事亦老溫帖木兒復武安州等三十餘城。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Yol Temür, chief minister of the Secretariat, recovered Wu'an Prefecture and more than thirty other cities.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Yol Temür, chief minister of the Secretariat, recovered Wu'an prefecture and more than thirty other cities.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命搠思監為右丞相，太平為左丞相，詔天下。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Suosijian was made right chief minister and Taiping was made left chief minister; an edict was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Suosijian was appointed right chief minister and Taiping was appointed left chief minister, and an edict was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 免民今歲稅糧之半。

translations.literal: Half of this year's grain tax was remitted for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's grain tax was remitted for the people.

sentences.zh: 詔以永昌宣慰司屬詹事院。

translations.literal: An edict placed the Yongchang Pacification Commission under the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed the Yongchang pacification commission under the household of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰朔，以實理門為中書分省右丞，守濟寧。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiachen new moon; Shiremen was made right vice director of the Branch Secretariat and ordered to defend Jining.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of jiachen, Shiremen was appointed right vice director of the branch secretariat and ordered to defend Jining.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，監察御史脫脫穆而言：「去歲河南之賊窺伺河北，惟河南與山東互相策應，為害尤大。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, investigating censor Toghto Muer said: "Last year the bandits of Henan watched for an opening in Hebei; only because Henan and Shandong supported each other did the harm become especially great.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, investigating censor Toghto Muer said: "Last year the rebels of Henan watched for an opening in Hebei; only because Henan and Shandong supported each other did the damage become especially severe.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，中書當遴選能將，就太不花、答失八都魯、阿魯三處軍馬內，擇其精銳，以守河北，進可以制河南之侵，退可以攻山東之寇，庶幾無虞。

translations.literal: As a measure for the present, the Secretariat should select able generals and, from the troops at the three stations of Toqto'a, Darmabala, and Aru, choose their elite forces to guard Hebei—advancing they can check Henan's incursions, retreating they can strike Shandong's bandits, and thus there may be little cause for worry."
translations.idiomatic: For the present, the Secretariat should select able generals and, from the troops at the three stations of Toqto'a, Darmabala, and Aru, choose their elite forces to guard Hebei; advancing they can check incursions from Henan, retreating they can strike rebels in Shandong, and thus the realm may be kept secure."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 己未，以帖裏帖木兒、老的沙並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Tegel Temür and Laodsha were both made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Tegel Temür and Laodsha were both appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大明兵取江陰州。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Ming forces captured Jiangyin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Ming forces captured Jiangyin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，帖裏帖木兒糾陜西知行樞密院事也先帖木兒，遂命罷陜西行樞密院，令也先帖木兒居於草地。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Tegel Temür impeached Yesun Temür, acting commissioner of the Shaanxi Branch Bureau of Military Affairs; the Shaanxi branch bureau was then abolished, and Yesun Temür was ordered to reside on the steppe.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Tegel Temür impeached Yesun Temür, acting commissioner of the Shaanxi branch bureau of military affairs; the Shaanxi branch bureau was then abolished, and Yesun Temür was ordered to reside on the steppe.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，溫州路樂清江中龍起，颶風作，有火光如球。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, in the Yueqing River of Wenzhou Circuit a dragon rose, a hurricane arose, and there was a ball of firelight.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, in the Yueqing River of Wenzhou circuit a dragon rose, a hurricane arose, and a ball of fire appeared.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉福通犯汴梁，其軍分三道，關先生、破頭潘、馮長舅、沙劉二、王士誠寇晉、冀，白不信、大刀敖、李喜喜趨關中，毛貴據山東，其勢大振。

translations.literal: That month, Liu Futong attacked Bianliang; his army divided into three routes—Master Guan, Potou Pan, Feng Changjiu, Sha Liu'er, and Wang Shicheng raided Jin and Ji; Bai Buxin, Dadao Ao, and Li Xixi pressed into Guanzhong; Mao Gui held Shandong—and their power greatly revived.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liu Futong attacked Bianliang; his army divided into three routes—Master Guan, Potou Pan, Feng Changjiu, Sha Liu'er, and Wang Shicheng raided Shanxi and Hebei; Bai Buxin, Dadao Ao, and Li Xixi pressed into Guanzhong; Mao Gui held Shandong—and their power greatly revived.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，帖裏帖木兒奏續集《風憲宏綱》。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jimao day; Tegel Temür memorialized a continuation of the Comprehensive Outline of Surveillance and Rectification.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the jimao day of the seventh month, Tegel Temür memorialized a continuation of the Comprehensive Outline of Surveillance and Rectification.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大明兵取徽州路。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Ming forces captured Huizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Ming forces captured Huizhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Venus transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Venus transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命右丞相搠思監領宣政院事，平章政事臧卜知經筵事，參知政事李稷同知經筵事，參知政事完者帖木兒兼太府卿。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, right chief minister Suosijian was ordered to take charge of the Court for the Spread of Governance; chief minister Zangbu was made director of the Classics Colloquium; associate chief minister Li Ji was made associate director of the Classics Colloquium; and associate chief minister Qanji Temür was made concurrently director of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, right chief minister Suosijian was ordered to take charge of the Court for the Spread of Governance; chief minister Zangbu was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium; associate chief minister Li Ji was appointed associate director of the Classics Colloquium; and associate chief minister Qanji Temür was appointed concurrently director of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，填星犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以李稷為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Li Ji was made vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Li Ji was appointed vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「山東般陽、益都相次而陷，濟南日危，宜選將練卒，信賞必罰，為保燕、趙計，以衛京師。

translations.literal: A minister of the Secretariat said: "Banyang and Yidu in Shandong have fallen one after another; Jinan grows more perilous by the day. Able generals and drilled troops should be selected, rewards and punishments made certain, to secure Yan and Zhao and guard the capital."
translations.idiomatic: A minister of the Secretariat said: "Banyang and Yidu in Shandong have fallen one after another, and Jinan grows more perilous by the day. Able generals and drilled troops should be selected, with rewards and punishments made certain, to secure Yan and Zhao and guard the capital."

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: " No response was given.
translations.idiomatic: No response was given.

sentences.zh: 己丑，鎮守黃河義兵萬戶田豐叛，陷濟寧路，分省右丞實理門遁，義兵萬戶孟本周攻之，田豐敗走，本周還守濟寧。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Tian Feng, commander of the righteous militia guarding the Yellow River, rebelled and captured Jining Circuit; Shiremen, right vice director of the branch secretariat, fled; the righteous-militia commander Meng Benzhou attacked him; Tian Feng was defeated and fled; Benzhou returned to defend Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Tian Feng, commander of the righteous militia guarding the Yellow River, rebelled and captured Jining circuit; Shiremen, right vice director of the branch secretariat, fled; the righteous-militia commander Meng Benzhou attacked him; Tian Feng was defeated and fled, and Benzhou returned to defend Jining.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以御史中丞完者帖木兒為中書右丞，河南廉訪使俺普為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Qanji Temür, vice censor-in-chief, was made right vice director of the Secretariat, and Anpu, surveillance commissioner of Henan, was made associate chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Qanji Temür, vice censor-in-chief, was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat, and Anpu, surveillance commissioner of Henan, was appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 監察御史叠裏彌實、劉傑言：「疆域日蹙，兵律不嚴，陜西、汴梁、淮潁、山東之寇有窺伺燕、趙之志，宜俯詢大臣，共圖克復之宜，預定守備之策。

translations.literal: Investigating censors Diermishi and Liu Jie said: "The realm shrinks daily, military discipline is lax, and bandits in Shaanxi, Bianliang, Huaiying, and Shandong watch for a chance against Yan and Zhao; the emperor should consult the chief ministers on measures for recovery and settle defensive plans in advance."
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors Diermishi and Liu Jie said: "The realm shrinks daily, military discipline is lax, and rebels in Shaanxi, Bianliang, Huaiying, and Shandong watch for a chance against Yan and Zhao; the emperor should consult the chief ministers on measures for recovery and settle defensive plans in advance."

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: " No response was given.
translations.idiomatic: No response was given.

sentences.zh: 是月，立四方獻言詳定使司，秩正三品。

translations.literal: That month, the Bureau for the Examination and Ratification of Advice Submitted from the Four Quarters was established, rank third grade, upper.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the bureau for the examination and ratification of advice submitted from the four quarters was established at the third rank, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 歸德府知府林茂、萬戶時公權叛，以城降於賊，歸德府及曹州皆陷。

translations.literal: Lin Mao, prefect of Guide Prefecture, and Shi Gongquan, commander of ten thousand, rebelled and surrendered the city to bandits; Guide Prefecture and Caozhou both fell.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Mao, prefect of Guide prefecture, and Shi Gongquan, commander of ten thousand, rebelled and surrendered the city to the rebels; Guide prefecture and Caozhou both fell.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯朔，填星犯鬼宿，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guimao new moon; Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation, and Venus transgressed the Chariot Axle constellation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of guimao, Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation and Venus transgressed the Chariot Axle constellation.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，劉福通兵陷大名路，遂自曹、濮陷衛輝路，答失八都魯之子孛羅帖木兒與萬戶方脫脫擊之。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Liu Futong's troops captured Daming Circuit, then from Cao and Pu captured Weihui Circuit; Bolad Temür, son of Darmabala, and the commander Fang Toto attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Liu Futong's troops captured Daming circuit, then advanced from Cao and Pu to capture Weihui circuit; Bolad Temür, son of Darmabala, and the commander Fang Toto attacked them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯五車。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Five Chariots constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Five Chariots constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以陜西行臺御史中丞伯嘉訥為陜西行省平章政事；

translations.literal: On yichou day, Bojian'a, vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, was made chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Bojian'a, vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate, was appointed chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat;

sentences.zh: 淮南行省參知政事余闕為淮南行省左丞；

translations.literal: Yu Que, associate chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat, was made left vice director of the Huainan Branch Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Yu Que, associate chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, was appointed left vice director of the Huainan branch secretariat;

sentences.zh: 江浙行省參知政事楊完者升左丞；

translations.literal: Yang Waner, associate chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, was promoted to left vice director;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Waner, associate chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was promoted to left vice director;

sentences.zh: 方國珍為江浙行省參知政事，海道運糧萬戶如故。

translations.literal: Fang Guozhen was made associate chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, retaining his post as commander of ten thousand for grain transport by sea.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guozhen was appointed associate chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat while retaining his post as commander of ten thousand for grain transport by sea.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，慶陽府鎮原州大雹。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, great hail fell in Zhenyuan Prefecture, Qingyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, great hail fell in Zhenyuan prefecture, Qingyang circuit.

sentences.zh: 是月，大駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 薊州大水。

translations.literal: Ji Prefecture suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Ji prefecture suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 詔知樞密院事紐的該進討山東。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Nudide, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to advance and suppress Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Nudide, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, to advance and suppress Shandong.

sentences.zh: 大明兵取揚州路。

translations.literal: Ming forces captured Yangzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces captured Yangzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 平江路張士誠，俾前江南行臺御史中丞蠻子海牙為書請降，江浙左丞相達識帖睦邇承制令參知政事周伯琦等至平江撫諭之，詔以士誠為太尉，士德為淮南行省平章政事，時士德已為大明兵所擒。

translations.literal: Zhang Shicheng of Pingjiang Circuit had the former vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, Manzi Haiya, write a letter requesting surrender; Dashi Timur, left chief minister of Jiangzhe, acting by imperial order, sent associate chief minister Zhou Boqi and others to Pingjiang to reassure him; an edict made Shicheng grand commander and Shide chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat—by then Shide had already been captured by Ming forces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shicheng of Pingjiang circuit had the former vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, Manzi Haiya, write a letter requesting surrender; Dashi Timur, left chief minister of Jiangzhe, acting by imperial order, sent associate chief minister Zhou Boqi and others to Pingjiang to reassure him; an edict made Shicheng grand commander and Shide chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat—by then Shide had already been captured by Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，命同知樞密院事壽童以兵討冠州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingzi day; Shoutong, associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to lead troops to suppress Guan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingzi day, Shoutong, associate commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, was ordered to lead troops to suppress Guan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以老的沙為中書省平章政事兼兀良海牙指揮使。

translations.literal: Laodsha was made chief minister of the Secretariat and concurrently commander of the Uighur Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Laodsha was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat and concurrently commander of the Uighur Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲午，澤州陵川縣陷，縣尹張輔死之。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Lingchuan County of Ze Prefecture fell; the county magistrate Zhang Fu died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Lingchuan county of Ze prefecture fell; the county magistrate Zhang Fu was killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太不花復大名路並所屬郡縣。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Toqto'a recovered Daming Circuit and its subordinate prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Toqto'a recovered Daming circuit and its subordinate prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔中書右丞也先不花、御史中丞成遵奉使宣撫彰德、大名、廣平、東昌、東平、曹、濮等處，獎厲將帥。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, an edict ordered Yesun Buqa, right vice director of the Secretariat, and Cheng Zun, vice censor-in-chief, to go as imperial envoys to pacify and reassure Zhangde, Daming, Guangping, Dongchang, Dongping, Cao, Pu, and other places, and to encourage the generals.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, an edict ordered Yesun Buqa, right vice director of the Secretariat, and Cheng Zun, vice censor-in-chief, to go as imperial envoys to pacify and reassure Zhangde, Daming, Guangping, Dongchang, Dongping, Cao, Pu, and other places and to encourage the generals.

sentences.zh: 是月，命紐的該加太尉，總諸軍守禦東昌。

translations.literal: That month, Nudide was promoted to grand commander and ordered to command all troops defending Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Nudide was promoted to grand commander and ordered to command all troops defending Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 時田豐據濟、濮，率眾來寇，擊走之。

translations.literal: At the time Tian Feng held Ji and Pu; he led a host to raid, and Nudide drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Tian Feng held Ji and Pu; he led a host to raid, and Nudide drove him off.

sentences.zh: 倪文俊謀殺其主徐壽輝，不果，自漢陽奔黃州，壽輝偽將陳友諒襲殺之，友諒遂自稱平章。

translations.literal: Ni Wenjun plotted to kill his lord Xu Shouhui but failed; he fled from Hanyang to Huangzhou; Xu Shouhui's false general Chen Youliang attacked and killed him, and Youliang then styled himself chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Ni Wenjun plotted to kill his lord Xu Shouhui but failed and fled from Hanyang to Huangzhou; Xu Shouhui's general Chen Youliang attacked and killed him, and Youliang then styled himself chief minister.

sentences.zh: 閏九月癸卯，有飛星如盂，青色，光燭地，尾約長尺餘，起自王良，沒於勾陳。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, guimao day; a flying star like a bowl, blue-green in color, its light illuminating the ground, its tail about a foot long, rose from Wangliang and set in Gouchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on the guimao day, a flying star like a bowl, blue-green in color, lit the ground with its light; its tail was about a foot long; it rose from Wangliang and set in Gouchen.

sentences.zh: 監察御史朵兒只等劾奏知樞密院使哈剌八禿兒失陷所守郡縣，詔正其罪。

translations.literal: Investigating censors Dorji and others memorialized impeaching Qara Badur, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, for losing the prefectures and counties he had been charged to defend; an edict ordered his punishment according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors Dorji and others memorialized impeaching Qara Badur, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, for losing the prefectures and counties he had been charged to defend; an edict ordered that he be punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 右丞相搠思監、左丞相太平並加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Right chief minister Suosijian and left chief minister Taiping were both promoted to acting with the protocol of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Right chief minister Suosijian and left chief minister Taiping were both promoted to acting with the protocol of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 平章政事完者不花兼大司農。

translations.literal: Qanbuqa, chief minister of the Secretariat, was made concurrently grand minister of agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Qanbuqa, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed concurrently grand minister of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，潞州陷。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Lu Prefecture fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Lu prefecture fell.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賊攻冀寧，察罕帖木兒以兵擊走之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, bandits attacked Jining; Chaghan Temür led troops and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, rebels attacked Jining; Chaghan Temür led troops and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，熒惑犯氐宿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yihai day; Mars transgressed the Root constellation.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the yihai day of the tenth month, Mars transgressed the Root constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，設分詹事院。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, a branch household of the heir apparent was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, a branch household of the heir apparent was established.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰掩昴宿。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon occulted the Hairy Head constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon occulted the Hairy Head constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，曹州賊入太行山。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, bandits from Caozhou entered the Taihang Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, rebels from Caozhou entered the Taihang Mountains.

sentences.zh: 是月，白不信、大刀敖、李喜喜陷興元，遂入鳳翔，察罕帖木兒、李思齊屢擊破之，其黨走入蜀。

translations.literal: That month, Bai Buxin, Dadao Ao, and Li Xixi captured Xingyuan, then entered Fengxiang; Chaghan Temür and Li Siji repeatedly defeated them, and their followers fled into Shu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Bai Buxin, Dadao Ao, and Li Xixi captured Xingyuan and then entered Fengxiang; Chaghan Temür and Li Siji repeatedly routed them, and their followers fled into Shu.

sentences.zh: 答失八都魯與知樞密院事答裏麻失裏以軍討曹州賊，官軍敗潰，答裏麻失裏死之。

translations.literal: Darmabala and Dalimashi, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, led troops to suppress the bandits of Caozhou; the government army was defeated and routed, and Dalimashi died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Darmabala and Dalimashi, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, led troops to suppress the rebels of Caozhou; the government army was defeated and routed, and Dalimashi died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 靜江路山崩，地陷，大水。

translations.literal: In Jingjiang Circuit the mountains collapsed, the ground gave way, and there was great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingjiang circuit the mountains collapsed, the ground gave way, and there was severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑朔，山東道宣慰使董摶霄建言：「請令江淮等處各枝官軍，分布連珠營寨於隘口，屯駐守禦，宜廣屯田，以足軍食。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinchou new moon; Dong Bowo, pacification commissioner of the Shandong Circuit, memorialized: "It is requested that the various branch government troops in the Jianghuai region and elsewhere be distributed in linked encampments at narrow passes, garrisoned for defense; garrison farming should be expanded to supply sufficient military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon of xinchou, Dong Bowo, pacification commissioner of the Shandong circuit, memorialized: "The various branch government troops in the Jianghuai region and elsewhere should be distributed in linked encampments at narrow passes and garrisoned for defense; garrison farming should be expanded to supply sufficient military provisions.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 汾州桃杏花。

translations.literal: Peach and apricot blossoms appeared in Fen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Peach and apricot blossoms appeared in Fen prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賊侵壺關，察罕帖木兒大破之。

translations.literal: On renyin day, bandits invaded Huguan; Chaghan Temür inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, rebels invaded Huguan, and Chaghan Temür inflicted a great defeat on them.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以河南行省平章政事答蘭為中書平章政事，御史中丞李獻為中書左丞，陜西行臺中丞卜顏帖木兒、樞密院副使哈剌那海、司農少卿崔敬、侍御史陳敬伯皆為參知政事。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Dalan, chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was made chief minister of the Secretariat; Li Xian, vice censor-in-chief, was made left vice director of the Secretariat; Buyan Temür, vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, Qara Nohai, associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Cui Jing, vice minister of the Bureau of Agriculture, and Chen Jingbo, attending censor, were all made associate chief ministers of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Dalan, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat; Li Xian, vice censor-in-chief, was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat; Buyan Temür, vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate, Qara Nohai, associate commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, Cui Jing, vice minister of the bureau of agriculture, and Chen Jingbo, attending censor, were all appointed associate chief ministers of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，豫王阿剌忒納失裏與陜西行省左丞相朵朵、陜西行臺御史中丞伯嘉訥，分道攻討關陜。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Prince Yu Ala Temür, Dudu, left chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, and Boghachu, vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, advanced by separate routes to attack and suppress Guan and Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Prince Yu Ala Temür, Dudu, left chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, and Boghachu, vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate, advanced by separate routes to attack and suppress Guan and Shaan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以中書參知政事八都麻失裏為右丞。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Badumashi, associate chief minister of the Secretariat, was made right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Badumashi, associate chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed right vice director.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午朔，熒惑犯天江。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu new moon; Mars transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the new moon of gengwu, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 辛未，山東道廉訪使伯顏不花建言：嚴保伍，集勇健，汰冗官。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Bayan Buhua, surveillance commissioner of the Shandong Circuit, memorialized: tighten the mutual-responsibility system of five households, gather brave and stalwart men, and dismiss redundant officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Bayan Buhua, surveillance commissioner of the Shandong circuit, memorialized that the mutual-responsibility system of five households should be tightened, brave and stalwart men gathered, and redundant officials dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Venus transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Venus transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，歲星犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Jupiter transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Jupiter transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，慶元路象山縣鵝鼻山崩。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Goose-Nose Mountain in Xiangshan County, Qingyuan Circuit, collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Goose-Nose Mountain in Xiangshan county, Qingyuan circuit, collapsed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，流星如金星大，尾約長三尺餘，起自太陰，近東而沒，化為青白氣。

translations.literal: On jihai day, a meteor the size of Venus, its tail about three feet long, rose from the moon, vanished near the east, and turned into bluish-white vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, a meteor the size of Venus, with a tail about three feet long, rose from the moon, vanished near the east, and turned into bluish-white vapor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，答失八都魯卒於軍中。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Darmabala died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Darmabala died in camp.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔天下團結義兵，路、府、州、縣正官俱兼防禦事。

translations.literal: That year, an edict ordered the realm to muster righteous militia; the chief officials of circuits, prefectures, and counties were all to hold concurrently defensive duties.
translations.idiomatic: That year, an edict ordered the realm to muster righteous militia; the chief officials of circuits, prefectures, and counties were all to hold defensive duties concurrently.

sentences.zh: 詔淮南知行樞密院事脫脫領兵討淮南。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Toghto, acting commissioner of the Huainan Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, to lead troops to suppress Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Toghto, acting commissioner of the Huainan branch bureau of military affairs, to lead troops to suppress Huainan.

sentences.zh: 詔諭濟寧李秉彜、田豐等，令其出降，敘復元任；

translations.literal: An edict instructed Li Bingyi, Tian Feng, and others at Jining to surrender; their former Yuan posts would be restored;
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed Li Bingyi, Tian Feng, and others at Jining to surrender and promised that their former Yuan posts would be restored;

sentences.zh: 嘯亂士卒，仍給資糧，欲還鄉者聽。

translations.literal: soldiers who had joined the rebellion would still receive provisions, and those wishing to return home were permitted to do so.
translations.idiomatic: soldiers who had joined the rebellion would still receive provisions, and those who wished to return home were free to do so.

sentences.zh: 倪文俊陷川蜀諸郡，命偽元帥明玉珍守據之。

translations.literal: Ni Wenjun captured the various prefectures of Sichuan and Shu and appointed the false commander Ming Yuzhen to hold and occupy them.
translations.idiomatic: Ni Wenjun captured the various prefectures of Sichuan and Shu and appointed the false commander Ming Yuzhen to hold and occupy them.

sentences.zh: 趙君用及彭大之子早住同據淮安，趙僭稱永義王，彭僭稱魯淮王。

translations.literal: Zhao Junyong and Peng Da's son Zaozhu jointly held Huai'an; Zhao unlawfully styled himself King of Eternal Righteousness, and Peng unlawfully styled himself King of Lu and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Junyong and Peng Da's son Zaozhu jointly held Huai'an; Zhao unlawfully styled himself King of Eternal Righteousness, and Peng unlawfully styled himself King of Lu and Huai.

sentences.zh: 義兵千戶余寶殺其知樞密院事寶童以叛，降於毛貴。

translations.literal: Righteous-militia qianhu Yu Bao killed his commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Baotong, in rebellion and surrendered to Mao Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous-militia qianhu Yu Bao killed his commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, Baotong, in rebellion and surrendered to Mao Gui.

sentences.zh: 余寶遂據棣州。

translations.literal: Yu Bao then held Di Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Bao then seized Di prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河南大饑。

translations.literal: Henan suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Henan suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月辛丑，填星犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, spring, first month, xinchou day; Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the xinchou day of the first month of spring, Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，察罕帖木兒、李思齊合兵於鳳翔。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Chaghan Temür and Li Siji united their armies at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Chaghan Temür and Li Siji united their armies at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation.

sentences.zh: 陳友諒陷安慶路，守將余闕死之。

translations.literal: Chen Youliang captured Anqing Circuit; the defending commander Yu Que died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Youliang captured Anqing circuit; the defending commander Yu Que died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大明兵取婺源州。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Ming forces captured Wuyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Ming forces captured Wuyuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以不蘭奚知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Bulanxi was made commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Bulanxi was appointed commissioner of the bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大風起自西北，益都土門萬歲碑仆而碎。

translations.literal: On yichou day, a great wind rose from the northwest; the Long-Life Stele at Tumen in Yidu fell and shattered.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, a great wind rose from the northwest; the Long-Life Stele at Tumen in Yidu toppled and shattered.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，田豐陷東平路。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Tian Feng captured Dongping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Tian Feng captured Dongping circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，不蘭奚與毛貴戰於好石橋，敗績，走濟南。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Bulanxi fought Mao Gui at Haoshi Bridge, was defeated, and fled to Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Bulanxi fought Mao Gui at Haoshi Bridge, was defeated, and fled to Jinan.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔答失八都魯子孛羅帖木兒為河南行省平章政事，總領其父元管軍馬。

translations.literal: That month, an edict made Bolad Temür, son of Darmabala, chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, in overall command of the army and horses his father had originally commanded.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict made Bolad Temür, son of Darmabala, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, with overall command of the army and horses his father had originally commanded.

sentences.zh: 詔察罕帖木兒屯陜西，李思齊屯鳳翔。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chaghan Temür to encamp in Shaanxi and Li Siji to encamp at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Chaghan Temür to encamp in Shaanxi and Li Siji to encamp at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳朔，議團結西山寨大小十一處以為保障，命中書右丞塔失帖木兒、左丞烏古孫良楨等總行提調，設萬夫長、千夫長、百夫長，編立牌甲，分守要害，互相策應。

translations.literal: Second month, jisi new moon; it was proposed to muster eleven large and small fortified positions in the Western Mountain Stockades as a protective bulwark; Tash Temür, right vice director of the Secretariat, Ulughsun Liangzhen, left vice director, and others were ordered to take overall charge of the mobilization; wanhu, qianhu, and baihu were established, household registers and armor rolls were compiled, and they were assigned to guard strategic points with mutual support.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon of jisi, it was proposed to muster eleven large and small fortified positions in the Western Mountain Stockades as a protective bulwark; Tash Temür, right vice director of the Secretariat, Ulughsun Liangzhen, left vice director, and others were ordered to take overall charge of the mobilization; wanhu, qianhu, and baihu were established, household registers and armor rolls compiled, and forces assigned to guard strategic points with mutual support.

sentences.zh: 毛貴陷清、滄州，遂據長蘆鎮。

translations.literal: Mao Gui captured Qing and Cang Prefectures and then held Changlu town.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Gui captured Qing and Cang prefectures and then seized Changlu town.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣奏以陜西軍旅事劇務殷，去京師道遠，供費艱難，請就陜西印造寶鈔為便，遂分戶部寶鈔庫等官，置局印造。

translations.literal: A minister of the Secretariat memorialized that military affairs in Shaanxi were urgent and pressing, the distance from the capital made supply costly and difficult, and it would be convenient to print treasure notes in Shaanxi itself; the treasury officials of the Bureau of Revenue for treasure notes were therefore divided off and offices established for printing.
translations.idiomatic: A minister of the Secretariat memorialized that military affairs in Shaanxi were urgent and pressing, that the distance from the capital made supply costly and difficult, and that it would be convenient to print treasure notes in Shaanxi itself; the treasury officials of the bureau of revenue for treasure notes were therefore divided off and offices established for printing.

sentences.zh: 仍命諸路撥降鈔本，畀平準行用庫倒易昏幣，布於民間。

translations.literal: An edict still ordered the circuits to allocate paper-note reserves, hand them to the exchange and circulation treasury to trade for worn currency, and circulate them among the people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict still ordered the circuits to allocate paper-note reserves, hand them to the exchange and circulation treasury to trade for worn currency, and circulate them among the people.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，毛貴陷濟南路，守將愛的戰死。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Mao Gui captured Jinan Circuit; the defending commander Aidi died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Mao Gui captured Jinan circuit; the defending commander Aidi died in battle.

sentences.zh: 毛貴立賓興院，選用故官，以姬宗周等分守諸路；

translations.literal: Mao Gui established a Recruitment and Promotion Academy, selected former officials for service, and assigned Ji Zongzhou and others to defend the various circuits respectively;
translations.idiomatic: Mao Gui established a Recruitment and Promotion Academy, selected former officials for service, and assigned Ji Zongzhou and others to defend the various circuits respectively;

sentences.zh: 又於萊州立三百六十屯田，每屯相去三十里，造大車百輛，以挽運糧儲，官民田十止收二分，冬則陸運，夏則水運。

translations.literal: he also established three hundred and sixty garrison-farm colonies at Lai Prefecture, each colony thirty li apart, built one hundred large carts to haul grain stores, collected only two parts in ten from official and private fields, transporting by land in winter and by water in summer.
translations.idiomatic: he also established three hundred and sixty garrison-farm colonies at Lai prefecture, each thirty li apart, built one hundred large carts to haul grain stores, collected only two parts in ten from official and private fields, and transported by land in winter and by water in summer.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，填星犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Saturn transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔以太不花為中書右丞相，總兵山東。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, an edict made Toqto'a right chief minister of the Secretariat with overall command of armies in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, an edict made Toqto'a right chief minister of the Secretariat with overall command of armies in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬午，田豐復陷濟寧路。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Tian Feng again captured Jining Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Tian Feng again captured Jining circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲申，輝州陷。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Hui Prefecture fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Hui prefecture fell.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，紐的該聞田豐逼近東昌，棄城走。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Nudide, hearing that Tian Feng was pressing close to Dongchang, abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Nudide, hearing that Tian Feng was pressing close to Dongchang, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，察罕帖木兒調兵復涇州、平涼，保鞏昌。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Chaghan Temür deployed troops to recover Jing Prefecture and Pingliang and to hold Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Chaghan Temür deployed troops to recover Jing prefecture and Pingliang and to hold Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，田豐陷東昌路。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Tian Feng captured Dongchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Tian Feng captured Dongchang circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，王士誠自益都犯懷慶路，周全擊敗之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Wang Shicheng advanced from Yidu to attack Huaqing Circuit; Zhou Quan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Wang Shicheng advanced from Yidu to attack Huaqing circuit, and Zhou Quan defeated him.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以安童為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Antong was made associate chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Antong was appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，興元路陷。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Xingyuan Circuit fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Xingyuan circuit fell.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥朔，日色如血。

translations.literal: Third month, jihai new moon; the sun's color was like blood.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of jihai, the sun's color was like blood.

sentences.zh: 加右丞相搠思監太保。

translations.literal: Right chief minister Suosijian was promoted to grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Right chief minister Suosijian was promoted to grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚子，毛貴陷般陽路。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Mao Gui captured Banyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Mao Gui captured Banyang circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大同路夜黑氣蔽西方，有聲如雷；

translations.literal: On xinchou day, in Datong Circuit at night black vapor covered the west, and there was a sound like thunder;
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, in Datong circuit at night black vapor covered the west, and there was a sound like thunder;

sentences.zh: 少頃，東北方有雲如火，交射中天，遍地俱見火，空中有兵戈之聲。

translations.literal: after a short while, in the northeast there was cloud like fire, shooting rays to the center of the sky; fire was seen everywhere, and in the air there was the sound of weapons.
translations.idiomatic: after a short while, in the northeast there was cloud like fire shooting rays to the center of the sky; fire was seen everywhere, and in the air there was the sound of weapons.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，王士誠陷晉寧路，總管杜賽因不花死之。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Wang Shicheng captured Jinning Circuit; the prefect Du Sayin Buqa died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Wang Shicheng captured Jinning circuit; the prefect Du Sayin Buqa died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，察罕帖木兒遣賽因赤等復晉寧路。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Chaghan Temür dispatched Sayinchi and others to recover Jinning Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Chaghan Temür dispatched Sayinchi and others to recover Jinning circuit.

sentences.zh: 己酉，劉福通遣兵犯衛輝，孛羅帖木兒擊走之。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Liu Futong sent troops to attack Weihui; Bolad Temür drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Liu Futong sent troops to attack Weihui, and Bolad Temür drove them off.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，毛貴陷薊州，詔征四方兵入衛。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Mao Gui captured Ji Prefecture; an edict summoned troops from all quarters to enter the capital guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Mao Gui captured Ji prefecture; an edict summoned troops from all quarters to enter the capital guard.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，毛貴犯漷州，至棗林，樞密副使達國珍戰死，遂略柳林，同知樞密院事劉哈剌不花以兵擊敗之，貴走據濟南。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Mao Gui attacked Huo Prefecture and reached Zaolin; Daguozhen, associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, died in battle; he then plundered Liulin; Liu Qara Buqa, associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, defeated him with troops, and Gui fled and held Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Mao Gui attacked Huo prefecture and reached Zaolin; Daguozhen, associate commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, died in battle; Mao Gui then plundered Liulin; Liu Qara Buqa, associate commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, defeated him with troops, and Mao Gui fled and seized Jinan.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，大明兵取建德路。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Ming forces captured Jiande Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Ming forces captured Jiande circuit.

sentences.zh: 以周全為湖廣行省參知政事，統奧魯等軍，移鎮嵩州白龍寨。

translations.literal: Zhou Quan was made associate chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, placed in overall command of the auru and other armies, and transferred to garrison Bailong Stockade in Song Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Quan was appointed associate chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, placed in overall command of the auru and other armies, and transferred to garrison Bailong Stockade in Song prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冀寧路陷。

translations.literal: Jining Circuit fell.
translations.idiomatic: Jining circuit fell.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，田豐陷益都路。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Tian Feng captured Yidu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Tian Feng captured Yidu circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大同諸縣陷，察罕帖木兒遣關保等往擊之。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the various counties of Datong fell; Chaghan Temür dispatched Guannu and others to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the various counties of Datong fell; Chaghan Temür dispatched Guannu and others to attack them.

sentences.zh: 是時賊分二道犯晉、冀，一出沁州，一侵絳州。

translations.literal: At this time the bandits divided into two routes to attack Jin and Ji—one emerging from Qin Prefecture, the other invading Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the rebels divided into two routes to attack Jin and Ji—one emerging from Qin prefecture, the other invading Jiang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以老章為太子少保。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Laozhang was made junior tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Laozhang was appointed junior tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，陳友諒陷龍興路，省臣道童、火你赤棄城遁。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiashen day; Chen Youliang captured Longxing Circuit; the provincial ministers Daotong and Huonichi abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the jiashen day of the fourth month, Chen Youliang captured Longxing circuit; the provincial ministers Daotong and Huonichi abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 壬午，田豐陷廣平路，大掠，退保東昌。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Tian Feng captured Guangping Circuit, plundered greatly, and withdrew to hold Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Tian Feng captured Guangping circuit, plundered extensively, and withdrew to hold Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 詔令元帥方脫脫以兵復廣平。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the commander Fang Toto to lead troops to recover Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the commander Fang Toto to lead troops to recover Guangping.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以諸處捷音屢至，詔頒軍民事宜十一條。

translations.literal: On guimao day, because reports of victory arrived repeatedly from various places, an edict promulgated eleven articles on military and civilian affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, because reports of victory arrived repeatedly from various places, an edict promulgated eleven articles on military and civilian affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以翰林學士承旨蠻子為嶺北行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Manzi, grand academician of the Hanlin Academy, was made chief minister of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Manzi, grand academician of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed chief minister of the Lingbei branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Venus transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Venus transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲午，陳友諒遣王奉國陷瑞州路。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Chen Youliang dispatched Wang Fengguo to capture Ruizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Chen Youliang dispatched Wang Fengguo to capture Ruizhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒、李思齊會宣慰張良弼、郎中郭擇善、宣慰同知拜帖木兒、平章政事定住、總帥汪長生奴，各以所部兵討李喜喜於鞏昌，李喜喜敗入蜀。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür and Li Siji joined pacification commissioner Zhang Liangyu, bureau director Guo Zeshan, associate pacification commissioner Bait Temür, chief minister Dingzhu, and commander Wang Changshengnu; each led his own troops to suppress Li Xixi at Gongchang, and Li Xixi was defeated and fled into Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür and Li Siji joined pacification commissioner Zhang Liangyu, bureau director Guo Zeshan, associate pacification commissioner Bait Temür, chief minister Dingzhu, and commander Wang Changshengnu; each led his own troops to suppress Li Xixi at Gongchang, and Li Xixi was defeated and fled into Shu.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒駐清湫，李思齊駐斜坡，張良弼駐秦州，郭擇善駐崇信，拜帖木兒等駐通渭，定住駐臨洮，各自除路府州縣官，征納軍需。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür encamped at Qingqiu, Li Siji at Xiepo, Zhang Liangyu at Qin Prefecture, Guo Zeshan at Chongxin, Bait Temür and others at Tongwei, and Dingzhu at Lintao; each on his own appointed circuit, prefecture, and county officials and levied military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür encamped at Qingqiu, Li Siji at Xiepo, Zhang Liangyu at Qin prefecture, Guo Zeshan at Chongxin, Bait Temür and others at Tongwei, and Dingzhu at Lintao; each on his own appointed circuit, prefecture, and county officials and levied military supplies.

sentences.zh: 李思齊、張良弼又同襲殺拜帖木兒，分總其兵。

translations.literal: Li Siji and Zhang Liangyu again jointly launched a surprise attack and killed Bait Temür, dividing command of his troops between them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siji and Zhang Liangyu again jointly launched a surprise attack and killed Bait Temür, dividing command of his troops between them.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌朔，察罕帖木兒遣董克昌等以兵復冀寧。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuxu new moon; Chaghan Temür dispatched Dong Kechang and others with troops to recover Jining.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of wuxu, Chaghan Temür dispatched Dong Kechang and others with troops to recover Jining.

sentences.zh: 以方國珍為江浙行省左丞，兼海道運糧萬戶。

translations.literal: Fang Guozhen was made left vice director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat and concurrently commander of ten thousand for grain transport by sea.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guozhen was appointed left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat and concurrently commander of ten thousand for grain transport by sea.

sentences.zh: 詔察罕帖木兒還兵鎮冀寧。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chaghan Temür to return his troops to garrison Jining.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Chaghan Temür to return his troops to garrison Jining.

sentences.zh: 李思齊殺同僉樞密院事郭擇善。

translations.literal: Li Siji killed Guo Zeshan, associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siji killed Guo Zeshan, associate commissioner of the bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賊兵逾太行，察罕帖木兒部將關保擊敗之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, bandit troops crossed the Taihang Mountains; Guannu, a subordinate commander of Chaghan Temür, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, rebel troops crossed the Taihang Mountains; Guannu, a subordinate commander of Chaghan Temür, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 以察罕帖木兒為陜西行省右丞兼陜西行臺侍御史、同知河南行樞密院事。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür was made right vice director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat and concurrently attending censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate and associate commissioner of the Henan Branch Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür was appointed right vice director of the Shaanxi branch secretariat and concurrently attending censor of the Shaanxi branch censorate and associate commissioner of the Henan branch bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 劉福通攻汴梁。

translations.literal: Liu Futong attacked Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Futong attacked Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白犯填星。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Venus transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Venus transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 汴梁守將竹貞棄城遁，福通等遂入城，乃自安豐迎其偽主居之以為都。

translations.literal: Zhuzhen, the defending commander of Bianliang, abandoned the city and fled; Futong and the others then entered the city and brought their false ruler from Anfeng to dwell there and make it the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuzhen, the defending commander of Bianliang, abandoned the city and fled; Futong and the others then entered the city and brought their false ruler from Anfeng to dwell there and make it the capital.

sentences.zh: 陳友諒遣康泰、趙琮、鄧克明等以兵寇邵武路。

translations.literal: Chen Youliang dispatched Kang Tai, Zhao Cong, Deng Keming, and others with troops to raid Shaowu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Youliang dispatched Kang Tai, Zhao Cong, Deng Keming, and others with troops to raid Shaowu circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命太尉阿吉剌為甘肅行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Grand Commander Ajila was made left chief minister of the Gansu Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Grand Commander Ajila was appointed left chief minister of the Gansu branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，關保與賊戰於高平，大敗之。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Guannu fought bandits at Gaoping and inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Guannu fought rebels at Gaoping and inflicted a great defeat on them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，陳友諒陷吉安路。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Chen Youliang captured Ji'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Chen Youliang captured Ji'an circuit.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，監察御史七十等，糾劾太保、中書右丞相太不花。

translations.literal: On guichou day, investigating censors Qishi and others impeached Grand Guardian and right chief minister Toqto'a.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, investigating censors Qishi and others impeached Grand Guardian and right chief minister Toqto'a.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔削太不花官爵，安置蓋州。

translations.literal: On yimao day, an edict stripped Toqto'a of his office and rank and placed him under surveillance at Gaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, an edict stripped Toqto'a of his office and rank and confined him to Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 時太不花總兵山東，以知行樞密院悟良哈臺代之。

translations.literal: At the time Toqto'a was overall commander of armies in Shandong; Ulugh Qada'i, acting commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Toqto'a held overall command of armies in Shandong; Ulugh Qada'i, acting commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, replaced him.

sentences.zh: 命悟良哈臺節制河北諸軍，河南行省平章政事周全節制河南諸軍。

translations.literal: Ulugh Qada'i was ordered to take overall command of all armies in Hebei, and Zhou Quan, chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was ordered to take overall command of all armies in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Ulugh Qada'i was ordered to take overall command of all armies in Hebei, and Zhou Quan, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, was ordered to take overall command of all armies in Henan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，陳友諒兵陷撫州路。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Chen Youliang's troops captured Fuzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Chen Youliang's troops captured Fuzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲子，監察御史七十、燕赤不花等劾中書參知政事燕只不花。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, investigating censors Qishi, Yanchi Buqa, and others impeached Yanzhi Buqa, vice chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, investigating censors Qishi, Yanchi Buqa, and others impeached Yanzhi Buqa, vice chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，遼州蝗。

translations.literal: That month, Liaozhou suffered a locust plague.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liaozhou suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 山東地震，天雨白毛。

translations.literal: Shandong was struck by an earthquake, and white hair fell from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong was struck by an earthquake, and white filaments fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒自以劉尚質為冀寧路總管。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür on his own authority appointed Liu Shangzhi prefectural commander of Jining Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür on his own authority appointed Liu Shangzhi prefectural commander of Jining circuit.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰朔，太不花伏誅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuchen new moon; Toqto'a was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of wuchen, Toqto'a was executed.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒調虎林赤、關保同守潞州。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür transferred Hulinchi and Guannu jointly to defend Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür transferred Hulinchi and Guannu jointly to defend Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 拜察罕帖木兒陜西行省平章政事，便宜行事。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür was invested as chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür was appointed chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，關先生、破頭潘等陷遼州，虎林赤以兵擊走之，關先生等遂陷冀寧路。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Master Guan, Potou Pan, and others captured Liaozhou; Hulinchi drove them off with troops, but Master Guan and the others then captured Jining Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Master Guan, Potou Pan, and others captured Liaozhou; Hulinchi drove them off with troops, but Master Guan and the others then captured Jining circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命左丞相太平督諸軍守禦京城，便宜行事。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, left chief minister Taiping was ordered to supervise all armies in defending the capital, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, left chief minister Taiping was ordered to supervise all armies in defending the capital, with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 是月，汾州大疫。

translations.literal: That month, Fenzhou suffered a great epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fenzhou suffered a great epidemic.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉朔，周全據懷慶路以叛，附於劉福通。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingyou new moon; Zhou Quan seized Huaiqing Circuit in rebellion and attached himself to Liu Futong.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the new moon of dingyou in the seventh month, Zhou Quan seized Huaiqing circuit in rebellion and attached himself to Liu Futong.

sentences.zh: 時察罕帖木兒駐軍洛陽，遣伯帖木兒以兵守碗子城。

translations.literal: At the time Chaghan Temür was encamped at Luoyang and dispatched Bo Temür with troops to defend Wanzi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chaghan Temür was encamped at Luoyang and dispatched Bo Temür with troops to defend Wanzi Fort.

sentences.zh: 周全來戰，伯帖木兒為其所殺，周全遂盡驅懷慶民渡河，入汴梁。

translations.literal: Zhou Quan came to give battle; Bo Temür was killed by him; Zhou Quan then drove all the people of Huaiqing across the river and entered Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Quan came to give battle and killed Bo Temür; Zhou Quan then drove all the people of Huaiqing across the river and entered Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 不蘭奚以兵復般陽路，已而復陷。

translations.literal: Bulanxi with troops recovered Banyang Circuit, but soon afterward it fell again.
translations.idiomatic: Bulanxi recovered Banyang circuit with troops, but soon afterward it fell again.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Venus appeared in daytime.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，有賊兵犯京城，刑部郎中不花守西門，夜，開門擊退之。

translations.literal: On guichou day, bandit troops attacked the capital; Buqa, bureau director of the Ministry of Justice, defended the western gate; at night he opened the gate and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, rebel troops attacked the capital; Buqa, bureau director of the Ministry of Justice, defended the western gate; at night he opened the gate and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 己未，劉福通遣周全引兵攻洛陽，守將登城，以大義責全，全愧謝退兵，劉福通殺之。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Liu Futong dispatched Zhou Quan to lead troops in attacking Luoyang; the defending commander mounted the wall and rebuked Quan on grounds of righteousness; Quan, ashamed, apologized and withdrew his troops; Liu Futong killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Liu Futong dispatched Zhou Quan to lead troops in attacking Luoyang; the defending commander mounted the wall and rebuked Quan on grounds of righteous loyalty; Quan, ashamed, apologized and withdrew his troops, and Liu Futong had him killed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以完卜花、脫脫帖木兒為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Wan Buqa and Toghto Temür were made chief ministers of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Wan Buqa and Toghto Temür were appointed chief ministers of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，京師大水，蝗，民大饑。

translations.literal: That month, the capital suffered great flooding and locusts, and the people suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the capital suffered severe flooding and locusts, and the people fell into great famine.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯朔，江浙行省平章政事三旦八遁於福建。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingmao new moon; San Danba, chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, fled to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of dingmao, San Danba, chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, fled to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 先是，三旦八討饒州，貪財玩寇，久而無功，遂妄稱遷職福建行省。

translations.literal: Earlier, San Danba had campaigned against Raozhou; greedy for wealth, he dallied with the bandits, and after long efforts achieved no success; he then falsely claimed transfer to office in the Fujian Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, San Danba had campaigned against Raozhou; greedy for wealth, he dallied with the rebels, and after long efforts achieved no success; he then falsely claimed transfer to office in the Fujian branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 至福建，為廉訪僉事般若帖木兒所劾，拘之興化路。

translations.literal: When he reached Fujian, he was impeached by surveillance associate commissioner Banruo Temür and detained at Xinghua Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Fujian, he was impeached by surveillance associate commissioner Banruo Temür and detained at Xinghua circuit.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰掩心宿。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the moon occulted the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the moon occulted the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，陳友諒兵陷建昌路。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Chen Youliang's troops captured Jianchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Chen Youliang's troops captured Jianchang circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，義兵萬戶王信以滕州叛，降於毛貴。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, righteous militia commander Wang Xin rebelled with Tengzhou and surrendered to Mao Gui.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, righteous militia commander Wang Xin rebelled with Tengzhou and surrendered to Mao Gui.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰掩昴宿。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon occulted the Hairy Head constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon occulted the Hairy Head constellation.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以老的沙為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Laodsha was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Laodsha was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 詔作新風紀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the drafting of new regulations of conduct.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the drafting of new regulations of conduct.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉朔，詔授昔班帖木兒同知河東宣慰司事，其妻剌八哈敦雲中郡夫人，子觀音奴贈同知大同路事，仍旌表其門閭。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingyou new moon; an edict invested Sibaqan Temür as associate commissioner of the Hedong Pacification Commissioner's Office; his wife Labaha Dun was made Lady of Yunzhong Commandery; his son Guanyinnu was posthumously granted associate prefectural commander of Datong Circuit; and their gateway was still to be honored with a commemorative plaque.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of dingyou, an edict invested Sibaqan Temür as associate commissioner of the Hedong pacification commissioner's office; his wife Labaha Dun was made Lady of Yunzhong commandery; his son Guanyinnu was posthumously granted associate prefectural commander of Datong circuit; and their gateway was honored with a commemorative plaque.

sentences.zh: 先是，昔班帖木兒為趙王位下同知怯憐口總管府事，其妻嘗保育趙王，及是部落滅裏叛，欲殺王，昔班帖木兒與妻謀，以其子觀音奴服王平日衣冠居王宮，夜半，夫妻衛趙王微服遁去。
