translations.literal: Earlier, Sibaqan Temür had been associate director of the Household Registry of Qielian Households under the Prince of Zhao; his wife had once nursed and raised the Prince of Zhao; when the tribe of Mieli rebelled and wished to kill the prince, Sibaqan Temür and his wife plotted to dress their son Guanyinnu in the prince's daily robes and have him dwell in the princely palace; at midnight the husband and wife escorted the Prince of Zhao in plain dress as they fled.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Sibaqan Temür had been associate director of the household registry of qielian households under the Prince of Zhao; his wife had once nursed and raised the Prince of Zhao; when the tribe of Mieli rebelled and wished to kill the prince, Sibaqan Temür and his wife plotted to dress their son Guanyinnu in the prince's daily robes and have him dwell in the princely palace; at midnight the husband and wife escorted the Prince of Zhao in plain dress as they fled.

sentences.zh: 比賊至，遂殺觀音奴，趙王得免。

translations.literal: When the bandits arrived, they then killed Guanyinnu, and the Prince of Zhao escaped.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived, they killed Guanyinnu, and the Prince of Zhao escaped.

sentences.zh: 事聞，故旌其忠焉。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, his loyalty was therefore honored.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, his loyalty was therefore honored.

sentences.zh: 褒封唐贈諫議大夫劉為文節昌平侯。

translations.literal: Liu, whom Tang had posthumously invested as remonstrance grand master, was posthumously ennobled as Wénjié Marquis of Changping.
translations.idiomatic: Liu, whom Tang had posthumously invested as remonstrance grand master, was ennobled as Wénjié Marquis of Changping.

sentences.zh: 關先生攻保定路，不克，遂陷完州，掠大同、興和塞外諸郡。

translations.literal: Master Guan attacked Baoding Circuit but could not take it; he then captured Wanzhou and plundered Datong, Xinghe, and the outer prefectures beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Master Guan attacked Baoding circuit but could not take it; he then captured Wanzhou and plundered Datong, Xinghe, and the outer prefectures beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞張沖請立團練安撫勸農使司二道，一奉元延安等處，一鞏昌等處，從之。

translations.literal: Zhang Chong, left vice director of the Secretariat, requested the establishment of two bandit-suppression, pacification, and agricultural encouragement commissioner circuits—one for Fengyuan, Yan'an, and other places, and one for Gongchang and other places. The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chong, left vice director of the Secretariat, requested the establishment of two bandit-suppression, pacification, and agricultural encouragement commissioner circuits—one for Fengyuan, Yan'an, and other places, and one for Gongchang and other places. The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔命中書參知政事普顏不花、治書侍御史李國鳳經略江南。

translations.literal: On renyin day, an edict appointed Puyan Buqa, vice chief minister of the Secretariat, and Li Guofeng, supervising secretary of the Censorate, to oversee Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict appointed Puyan Buqa, vice chief minister of the Secretariat, and Li Guofeng, supervising secretary of the censorate, to oversee Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔以福建行中書省平章政事慶童為江南行臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict made Qingtong, chief minister of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an edict made Qingtong, chief minister of the Fujian branch secretariat, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賊兵攻大同路。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, bandit troops attacked Datong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, rebel troops attacked Datong circuit.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，平定州陷。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Pingding Prefecture fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Pingding prefecture fell.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，陳友諒陷贛州路，江西行省參知政事全普庵撒裏及總管哈海赤死之。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Chen Youliang captured Ganzhou Circuit; Quan Pu'an Sali, vice chief minister of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, and Prefectural Commander Haqaqi died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Chen Youliang captured Ganzhou circuit; Quan Pu'an Sali, vice chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, and prefectural commander Haqaqi died in the defense.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅朔，詔豫王阿剌忒納失裏徙居白海，尋遷六盤。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingyin new moon; an edict ordered Prince Yu Ala Temür to move his residence to Baihai; soon afterward he was transferred to Liupan.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the new moon of bingyin in the tenth month, an edict ordered Prince Yu Ala Temür to move his residence to Baihai; soon afterward he was transferred to Liupan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大明兵取蘭溪州。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Ming forces captured Lanxi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Ming forces captured Lanxi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation.

sentences.zh: 壬午，監察御史燕赤不花劾右丞相搠思監罪狀，詔收其印綬。

translations.literal: On renwu day, investigating censor Yanchi Buqa impeached right chief minister Suosijian for his crimes; an edict ordered his seals and credentials seized.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, investigating censor Yanchi Buqa impeached right chief minister Suosijian for his crimes; an edict ordered his seals and credentials seized.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，監察御史答兒麻失裏、王彜等復劾之，請正其罪，帝不聽。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, investigating censors Darmashi, Wang Yi, and others again impeached him, requesting that his guilt be formally adjudicated; the emperor did not heed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, investigating censors Darmashi, Wang Yi, and others again impeached him and requested that his guilt be formally adjudicated; the emperor did not heed them.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大同路陷，達魯花赤完者帖木兒棄城遁。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Datong Circuit fell; Wanjie Temür, the darughachi, abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Datong circuit fell; Wanjie Temür, the darughachi, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未朔，以普化帖木兒為福建行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yiwei new moon; Puhua Temür was made chief minister of the Fujian Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon of yiwei, Puhua Temür was appointed chief minister of the Fujian branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，陳友諒陷汀州路。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Chen Youliang captured Tingzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Chen Youliang captured Tingzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯昴宿，太白犯房宿。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation, and Venus transgressed the Room constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation, and Venus transgressed the Room constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁未，田豐陷順德路。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Tian Feng captured Shunde Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Tian Feng captured Shunde circuit.

sentences.zh: 先是，樞密院判官劉起祖守順德，糧絕，劫民財，掠牛馬，民強壯者令充軍，弱者殺而食之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Liu Qizu, administrative judge of the Bureau of Military Affairs, had defended Shunde; when provisions were exhausted, he plundered the people's wealth and seized oxen and horses; strong civilians he forced into military service, and the weak he killed and ate.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Liu Qizu, administrative judge of the bureau of military affairs, had defended Shunde; when provisions were exhausted, he plundered the people's wealth and seized oxen and horses; strong civilians he forced into military service, and the weak he killed for food.

sentences.zh: 至是城陷，起祖遂盡驅其民走於廣平。

translations.literal: When the city then fell, Qizu drove all the people to flee toward Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: When the city then fell, Qizu drove all the people to flee toward Guangping.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰掩心宿。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the moon occulted the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the moon occulted the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yichou new moon; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the new moon of yichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，關先生、破頭潘等陷上都，焚宮闕，留七日，轉略往遼陽，遂至高麗。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Master Guan, Potou Pan, and others captured Shangdu, burned the palace halls, remained seven days, then turned to raid toward Liaoyang, and finally reached Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Master Guan, Potou Pan, and others captured Shangdu, burned the palace halls, remained seven days, then turned to raid toward Liaoyang, and finally reached Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，察罕帖木兒遣樞密院判官瑣住進兵於遼陽。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Chaghan Temür dispatched Suozhu, administrative judge of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to advance troops toward Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Chaghan Temür dispatched Suozhu, administrative judge of the bureau of military affairs, to advance troops toward Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太白經天。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大明兵取婺州路，達魯花赤僧住、浙東廉訪使楊惠死之。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Ming forces captured Wuzhou Circuit; Sengzhu, the darughachi, and Yang Hui, surveillance commissioner of eastern Zhejiang, died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Ming forces captured Wuzhou circuit; Sengzhu, the darughachi, and Yang Hui, surveillance commissioner of eastern Zhejiang, died in the defense.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Room constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the moon transgressed the Room constellation.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月甲午朔，陳友諒兵陷信州路，守臣江東廉訪副使伯顏不花的斤力戰死之。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, spring, first month, jiawu new moon; Chen Youliang's troops captured Xinzhou Circuit; defending official Bayan Buqa's jin, deputy surveillance commissioner of Jiangdong, died fighting bravely in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on the new moon of jiawu in the first month of spring, Chen Youliang's troops captured Xinzhou circuit; Bayan Buqa's jin, deputy surveillance commissioner of Jiangdong, died fighting bravely in the defense.

sentences.zh: 大明兵取諸暨州。

translations.literal: Ming forces captured Zhuji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces captured Zhuji prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以朵兒只班為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Dorejiban was made chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Dorejiban was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遼陽行省陷，懿州路總管呂震死之，贈震河南行省左丞，追封東平郡公。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat fell; Lü Zhen, prefectural commander of Yizhou Circuit, died in the defense; Zhen was posthumously granted left vice director of the Henan Branch Secretariat and posthumously ennobled as Duke of Dongping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Liaoyang branch secretariat fell; Lü Zhen, prefectural commander of Yizhou circuit, died in the defense; Zhen was posthumously granted left vice director of the Henan branch secretariat and posthumously ennobled as Duke of Dongping commandery.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒遣樞密院判官陳秉直、八不沙將兵二萬守冀寧。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür dispatched Chen Bingzhi and Ba Basha, administrative judges of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to lead twenty thousand troops in defending Jining.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür dispatched Chen Bingzhi and Ba Basha, administrative judges of the bureau of military affairs, to lead twenty thousand troops in defending Jining.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，流星如酒杯大，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On guichou day, a meteor the size of a wine cup fell, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, a meteor the size of a wine cup fell, with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，樞密副使朵兒只以賊犯順寧，命張立將精銳由紫荊關出討，命鴉鶻由北口出迎敵。

translations.literal: Second month, xinsi day; Doreji, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, because bandits were attacking Shunning, ordered Zhang Li to lead elite troops out through Zijing Pass to suppress them and ordered Yahu to go out through the Northern Pass to meet the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinsi day, because rebels were attacking Shunning, Doreji, vice director of the bureau of military affairs, ordered Zhang Li to lead elite troops out through Zijing Pass to suppress them and ordered Yahu to go out through the Northern Pass to meet the enemy.

sentences.zh: 甲申，叛將梁炳攻辰州，守將和尚擊敗之，以和尚為湖廣行省參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, rebel general Liang Bing attacked Chenzhou; the defending commander Heshang defeated him; Heshang was made vice chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, rebel general Liang Bing attacked Chenzhou; the defending commander Heshang defeated him; Heshang was appointed vice chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 賊由飛狐、靈丘犯蔚州。

translations.literal: Bandits from Feihu and Lingqiu attacked Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Feihu and Lingqiu attacked Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，御史臺臣言：「先是召募義兵，費用銀鈔一百四十萬錠，多近侍、權幸冒名關支，率為虛數。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, censorate officials said: "Earlier, in recruiting righteous militia, one million four hundred thousand ingots of paper currency were spent; many court attendants and favorites falsely claimed names to draw payments, and these were largely fictitious numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, censorate officials said: "Earlier, in recruiting righteous militia, one million four hundred thousand ingots of paper currency were spent; many court attendants and favorites falsely claimed names to draw payments, and these were largely fictitious numbers.

sentences.zh: 乞令軍士，凡已領官錢者，立限出征。

translations.literal: It is requested that soldiers who have already received government funds be given a fixed deadline to take the field."
translations.idiomatic: It is requested that soldiers who have already received government funds be given a fixed deadline to take the field."

sentences.zh: 」詔從之，已而復止不行。

translations.literal: " An edict adopted the proposal, but soon afterward it was again halted and not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: An edict adopted the proposal, but soon afterward it was again halted and not implemented.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔孛羅帖木兒移兵鎮大同，以為京師捍蔽。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered Bolad Temür to shift troops to garrison Datong as a shield for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict ordered Bolad Temür to shift troops to garrison Datong as a shield for the capital.

sentences.zh: 置大都督兵農司，仍置分司十道，專督屯種，以孛羅帖木兒領之，所在侵奪民田，不勝其擾。

translations.literal: The Grand Directorate of Military-Agriculture was established in the capital, with branch directorates in ten circuits still established, solely to supervise garrison farming; Bolad Temür was placed in charge of it, and wherever it was established it seized civilian fields—the people could not endure the harassment.
translations.idiomatic: The grand directorate of military-agriculture was established in the capital, with branch directorates in ten circuits, solely to supervise garrison farming; Bolad Temür was placed in charge of it, and wherever it was established it seized civilian fields—the people could not endure the harassment.

sentences.zh: 太不花潰散之兵數萬鈔掠山西，察罕帖木兒遣陳秉直分兵駐榆次招撫之，其首領悉送河南屯種。

translations.literal: Several tens of thousands of Toqto'a's scattered troops plundered Shanxi; Chaghan Temür dispatched Chen Bingzhi to divide troops and encamp at Yuci to win them over; their leaders were all sent to Henan for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Several tens of thousands of Toqto'a's scattered troops plundered Shanxi; Chaghan Temür dispatched Chen Bingzhi to divide troops and encamp at Yuci to win them over; their leaders were all sent to Henan for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳朔，陳友諒遣兵由信州略衢州，復遣兵陷襄陽路。

translations.literal: Third month, guisi new moon; Chen Youliang dispatched troops from Xinzhou to raid Quzhou and again dispatched troops who captured Xiangyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of guisi, Chen Youliang dispatched troops from Xinzhou to raid Quzhou and again dispatched troops who captured Xiangyang circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，京城北兵馬司指揮周哈剌歹與林智和等謀叛，事覺，伏誅。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Zhou Qaraqai, commander of the northern capital military-horses office, and Lin Zhihe and others plotted rebellion; when the matter came to light, they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Zhou Qaraqai, commander of the northern capital military-horses office, and Lin Zhihe and others plotted rebellion; when the matter came to light, they were executed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Room constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Room constellation.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔定科舉流寓人名額，蒙古、色目、南人各十五名，漢人二十名。

translations.literal: On renxu day, an edict fixed examination quotas for sojourners—fifteen places each for Mongols, Semuren, and Southern persons, and twenty places for Han people.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, an edict fixed civil examination quotas for sojourners—fifteen places each for Mongols, Semuren, and Southern persons, and twenty places for Han people.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥朔，汾水暴漲。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guihai new moon; the Fen River rose violently.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the new moon of guihai in the fourth month, the Fen River rose violently.

sentences.zh: 賊陷金、復等州，司徒、知樞密院事佛家奴調兵平之。

translations.literal: Bandits captured Jin, Fu, and other prefectures; Grand Preceptor Fojianu, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, dispatched troops and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels captured Jin, Fu, and other prefectures; Grand Preceptor Fojianu, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, dispatched troops and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，毛貴為趙君用所殺。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Mao Gui was killed by Zhao Junyong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Mao Gui was killed by Zhao Junyong.

sentences.zh: 帝以天下多故，卻天壽節朝賀，詔群臣曰：「朕方今宜敬天地，法祖宗，以自修省。

translations.literal: Because many troubles afflicted the realm, the emperor declined the Tian Shou Festival court congratulations and issued an edict to the officials, saying: "At present I should revere Heaven and Earth, follow the ancestors, and engage in self-cultivation and introspection.
translations.idiomatic: Because many troubles afflicted the realm, the emperor declined the Tian Shou Festival court congratulations and issued an edict to the officials, saying: "At present I should revere Heaven and Earth, follow the ancestors, and engage in self-cultivation and introspection.

sentences.zh: 朕初度之日，群臣毋賀。

translations.literal: On the day of my birthday, officials are not to offer congratulations."
translations.idiomatic: On the day of my birthday, officials are not to offer congratulations."

sentences.zh: 」庚午，左丞相太平暨文武百官奏曰：「天壽節朝賀，乃臣子報本，實合禮典。

translations.literal: " On gengwu day, left chief minister Taiping together with civil and military officials memorialized, saying: "The Tian Shou Festival court congratulations are how subjects repay their root obligation and truly accord with ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, left chief minister Taiping together with civil and military officials memorialized, saying: "The Tian Shou Festival court congratulations are how subjects repay their root obligation and truly accord with ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 今謙讓不受，固陛下盛德，然今軍旅征進，君臣名分，正宜舉行。

translations.literal: Your refusal out of modesty is indeed Your Majesty's great virtue, yet with armies now campaigning, the proper names and stations of ruler and subjects ought precisely to be upheld."
translations.idiomatic: Your refusal out of modesty is indeed Your Majesty's great virtue, yet with armies now campaigning, the proper names and stations of ruler and subjects ought precisely to be upheld."

sentences.zh: 」不允。

translations.literal: " The request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，皇太子復率群臣上奏曰：「朝賀祝壽，是祖宗以來舊行典故，今不行，有乖於禮。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the heir apparent again led the officials in memorializing, saying: "Court congratulations for birthday wishes are an established precedent since the ancestors; not to perform them now departs from ritual propriety."
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the heir apparent again led the officials in memorializing, saying: "Court congratulations for birthday wishes are an established precedent since the ancestors; not to perform them now departs from ritual propriety."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「今盜賊未息，萬姓荼毒，正朕恐懼、修省、敬天之時，奈何受賀以自樂！

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Bandits and robbers have not yet been quelled, and the myriad people suffer bitterly—it is precisely the time when I should be fearful, introspective, and reverent toward Heaven; how could I accept congratulations to indulge myself!"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Bandits and robbers have not yet been quelled, and the myriad people suffer bitterly—it is precisely the time when I should be fearful, introspective, and reverent toward Heaven; how could I accept congratulations to indulge myself!"

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，御史大夫帖裏帖木兒復奏曰：「天壽朝賀之禮，蓋出臣子之誠，伏望陛下曲徇所請。

translations.literal: " On yihai day, censor-in-chief Tegel Temür again memorialized, saying: "The Tian Shou court congratulation rite arises from the sincerity of subjects; I humbly hope Your Majesty will graciously accede to this request.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, censor-in-chief Tegel Temür again memorialized, saying: "The Tian Shou court congratulation rite arises from the sincerity of subjects; I humbly hope Your Majesty will graciously accede to this request.

sentences.zh: 若朝賀之後，內庭燕集，特賜除免，亦古者人君減膳之意，仍乞宣示中書，使內外知聖天子憂勤惕厲至於如此。

translations.literal: If after the court congratulations the inner court banquet were specially exempted, that too would embody the ancient ruler's intent to reduce his own fare; I still beg that this be proclaimed to the Secretariat, so that within and without all may know that the sage Son of Heaven is so anxious, diligent, and vigilant."
translations.idiomatic: If after the court congratulations the inner court banquet were specially exempted, that too would embody the ancient ruler's intent to reduce his own fare; I still beg that this be proclaimed to the Secretariat, so that within and without all may know that the sage Son of Heaven is so anxious, diligent, and vigilant."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「為朕缺於修省，以致萬姓塗炭，今復朝賀燕集，是重朕之不德。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Because I have been deficient in introspection, the myriad people have been scorched and smitten; if I now restore court congratulations and banquets, that would only multiply my lack of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Because I have been deficient in introspection, the myriad people have been scorched and smitten; if I now restore court congratulations and banquets, that would only multiply my lack of virtue.

sentences.zh: 當候天下安寧，行之未晚。

translations.literal: I should wait until the realm is at peace—it will not be too late to perform them then.
translations.idiomatic: I should wait until the realm is at peace—it will not be too late to perform them then.

sentences.zh: 卿等其毋復言。

translations.literal: You officials, do not speak of this again.
translations.idiomatic: You officials, do not speak of this again.

sentences.zh: 」卒不聽。

translations.literal: " In the end he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he refused to listen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賊陷寧夏路，遂略靈武等處。

translations.literal: On jichou day, bandits captured Ningxia Circuit, then overran Lingwu and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, rebels captured Ningxia circuit and then overran Lingwu and other places.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，以陜西行臺御史大夫完者帖木兒為陜西行省左丞相，便宜行事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renchen new moon; Qanji Temür, censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, was made left chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of renchen, Qanji Temür, censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate, was appointed left chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 丙申，熒惑犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Mars transgressed the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Mars transgressed the Ghost constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇太子奏請巡北邊以撫綏軍民，御史臺臣上疏固留，詔從之。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the heir apparent memorialized requesting a tour of the northern frontier to comfort soldiers and civilians; censorate officials submitted a memorial firmly urging him to remain; an edict followed their advice.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the heir apparent memorialized requesting a tour of the northern frontier to comfort soldiers and civilians; officials of the censorate submitted a memorial firmly urging him to remain, and an edict followed their advice.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，察罕帖木兒請今歲八月鄉試河南舉人及避兵儒士，不拘籍貫，依河南省元定額數，就陜州置貢院應試，詔從之。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Chaghan Temür requested that in this year's eighth month provincial examination candidates from Henan and scholar-gentry who had fled the fighting, without restriction as to place of registration, according to Henan's original quota, be examined at an examination hall set up at Shaanzhou; an edict followed the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Chaghan Temür requested that in the eighth month of that year provincial examination candidates from Henan and scholar-gentry who had fled the fighting, without restriction as to place of registration and according to Henan's original quota, be examined at an examination hall set up at Shaanzhou; an edict approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 是月，察罕帖木兒大發秦、晉諸軍討汴梁，圍其城。

translations.literal: That month, Chaghan Temür mustered in force armies from Qin and Jin to suppress Bianliang and besieged the city.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Chaghan Temür mustered in force the armies of Qin and Jin to suppress Bianliang and besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 山東、河東、河南、關中等處蝗飛蔽天，人馬不能行，所落溝塹盡平，民大饑。

translations.literal: In Shandong, Hedong, Henan, Guanzhong, and other regions locusts flew so thick as to darken the sky; men and horses could not advance; the ditches and ravines where they settled were leveled flat; the people suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In Shandong, Hedong, Henan, Guanzhong, and other regions locust swarms darkened the sky so that men and horses could not pass; the ditches and ravines where they settled were filled level, and the people fell into great famine.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，詔以宣徽使燕古兒為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinsi day; an edict made Yangu, commissioner of the Palace Attendants Service, censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinsi day, an edict appointed Yangu, commissioner of the palace attendants service, censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰朔，出搠思監為遼陽行省左丞相，便宜行事。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renchen new moon; Suosijian was transferred out and made left chief minister of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the new moon of renchen in the seventh month, Suosijian was transferred out and appointed left chief minister of the Liaoyang branch secretariat with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太白犯上將。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Venus transgressed the Supreme General constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Venus transgressed the Supreme General constellation.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔以察罕腦兒宣慰司之地屬資正院，有司毋得差占。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict ordered that the lands of the Chaghan Na'ur Pacification Commission be assigned to the Zizheng Court, and that the regular authorities were not to reassign or occupy them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, an edict ordered that the lands of the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission be assigned to the Zizheng Court, and that the regular authorities were not to reassign or occupy them.

sentences.zh: 察罕腦兒之地，在世祖時隸忙哥歹太子四千戶，今從皇后奇氏請，故以屬之資正院。

translations.literal: The lands of Chaghan Na'ur, in the time of Shizu, had belonged to Crown Prince Mangqaday's four thousand households; now, acceding to Empress Qi's request, they were therefore assigned to the Zizheng Court.
translations.idiomatic: The lands of Chaghan Na'ur had belonged in Shizu's time to the four thousand households of Crown Prince Mangqaday; now, acceding to Empress Qi's request, they were assigned to the Zizheng Court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太白犯右執法。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命國王囊加歹、中書平章政事佛家奴、也先不花、知樞密院事黑驢等，統領探馬赤軍進征遼陽。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Prince Nangjiadai, chief minister Fojianu of the Secretariat, Yesun Buqa, Heilü, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and others were ordered to take overall command of tumanshi troops and advance against Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Prince Nangjiadai, chief minister Fojianu of the Secretariat, Yesun Buqa, Heilü, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, and others were ordered to take overall command of tumanshi troops and advance against Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer constellation.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，趙君用既殺毛貴，其黨續繼祖自遼陽入益都，殺君用，遂與其所部自相仇敵。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, after Zhao Junyong had killed Mao Gui, his follower Xu Jizu entered Yidu from Liaoyang and killed Junyong; then his own followers turned against one another as enemies.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, after Zhao Junyong had killed Mao Gui, his follower Xu Jizu entered Yidu from Liaoyang and killed Junyong; his followers then fell to feuding among themselves.

sentences.zh: 是月，霸州及介休、靈石縣蝗。

translations.literal: That month, Bazhou and Jiexiu and Lingshi counties suffered locust plagues.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Bazhou and Jiexiu and Lingshi counties suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉朔，倪文俊余黨陷歸州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinyou new moon; remnant followers of Ni Wenjun captured Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of xinyou, remnant followers of Ni Wenjun captured Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，察罕帖木兒督諸將閻思孝、李克彜、虎林赤、賽因赤、答忽、脫因不花、呂文、完哲、賀宗哲、孫翥等攻破汴梁城，劉福通奉其偽主遁，退據安豐。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Chaghan Temür supervised the generals Yan Sixiao, Li Keyi, Hulinchi, Sayinchi, Dahu, Toqyin Buqa, Lü Wen, Wanzhe, He Zongzhe, Sun Zhu, and others in storming Bianliang; Liu Futong escorted his false ruler and fled, withdrawing to hold Anfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Chaghan Temür supervised the generals Yan Sixiao, Li Keyi, Hulinchi, Sayinchi, Dahu, Toqyin Buqa, Lü Wen, Wanzhe, He Zongzhe, Sun Zhu, and others in storming Bianliang; Liu Futong escorted his false ruler in flight and withdrew to hold Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 己卯，蝗自河北飛渡汴梁，食田禾一空。

translations.literal: On jimao day, locusts flew from Hebei across Bianliang and devoured the fields until nothing remained.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, locusts flew from Hebei across Bianliang and stripped the fields bare.

sentences.zh: 詔以察罕帖木兒為河南行省平章政事，兼同知河南行樞密院事、陜西行臺御史中丞，依前便宜行事，仍賜御衣、七寶腰帶，以旌其功。

translations.literal: An edict made Chaghan Temür chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, concurrently associate commissioner of the Henan Branch Bureau of Military Affairs and vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, with discretionary authority as before, and further bestowed upon him imperial robes and a seven-jeweled belt to honor his achievement.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Chaghan Temür chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, concurrently associate commissioner of the Henan branch bureau of military affairs and vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate, with discretionary authority as before, and further bestowed imperial robes and a seven-jeweled belt to honor his achievement.

sentences.zh: 是月，大同路蝗，襄垣縣螟蝝。

translations.literal: That month, Datong Circuit suffered locusts, and Xiangyuan County suffered rice-borer larvae.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Datong circuit suffered locusts, and Xiangyuan county suffered rice-borer larvae.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，以中書平章政事帖裏帖木兒為陜西行省左丞相，便宜行事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guisi day; Tegel Temür, chief minister of the Secretariat, was made left chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guisi day, Tegel Temür, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed left chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以湖南、北，江東、西四道廉訪司所治之地皆陷，詔任其所便之地置司。

translations.literal: On yisi day, because the territories under the four surveillance commissions of Hunan and Hubei and of Jiangdong and Jiangxi had all fallen, an edict allowed each commission to establish itself wherever convenient.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, because the territories administered by the four surveillance commissions of Hunan and Hubei and of Jiangdong and Jiangxi had all fallen, an edict allowed each to establish itself wherever convenient.

sentences.zh: 丙午，夜，白虹貫天。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, at night, a white rainbow spanned the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, at night a white rainbow spanned the sky.

sentences.zh: 丁未，禁軍人不得私殺牛馬。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, soldiers were forbidden to kill cattle and horses on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, soldiers were forbidden to kill cattle and horses on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太白犯天江。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Venus transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Venus transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取衢州路。

translations.literal: That month, Ming forces captured Quzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Ming forces captured Quzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 詔遣兵部尚書伯顏帖木兒、戶部尚書曹履亨，以禦酒、龍衣賜張士誠，征海運糧。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Bayan Temür, minister of war, and Cao Lüheng, minister of revenue, to bestow imperial wine and dragon robes upon Zhang Shicheng and to levy grain for sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched Bayan Temür, minister of war, and Cao Lüheng, minister of revenue, to bestow imperial wine and dragon robes upon Zhang Shicheng and to levy grain for transport by sea.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申朔，詔京師十一門皆築甕城，造吊橋。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengshen new moon; an edict ordered that barbican enclosures be built at all eleven gates of the capital and that drawbridges be constructed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the new moon of gengshen in the tenth month, an edict ordered barbican enclosures built at all eleven gates of the capital and drawbridges constructed.

sentences.zh: 以方國珍為江浙行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Fang Guozhen was made chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guozhen was appointed chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太白犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Venus transgressed the Dipper constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Venus transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，流星大如桃。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, a meteor as large as a peach appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, a meteor as large as a peach appeared.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，大明兵取處州路。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guimao day; Ming forces captured Chuzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guimao day, Ming forces captured Chuzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，陳友諒兵陷杉關。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Chen Youliang's troops captured Shan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Chen Youliang's troops captured Shan Pass.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuchen day; Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuchen day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 是月，知樞密院事兀良哈臺領太不花軍，其所部方脫脫與弟方伯帖木兒時保遼州，兀良哈臺同唐琰、高脫因等屯孟州，與察罕帖木兒部將八不沙等交兵。

translations.literal: That month, Ulugh Qada'i, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, commanded Toqto'a's army; his subordinate Fang Toto and his brother Fang Botemür were then defending Liaozhou; Ulugh Qada'i together with Tang Yan, Gao Toqyin, and others encamped at Mengzhou and clashed with Ba Basha and other generals under Chaghan Temür.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Ulugh Qada'i, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, commanded Toqto'a's army; his subordinate Fang Toto and his brother Fang Botemür were then defending Liaozhou; Ulugh Qada'i together with Tang Yan, Gao Toqyin, and others encamped at Meng Prefecture and clashed with Ba Basha and other generals under Chaghan Temür.

sentences.zh: 已而兀良哈臺獨引達達軍還京師，方脫脫等乃從孛羅帖木兒。

translations.literal: Before long Ulugh Qada'i alone led the Dada troops back to the capital, and Fang Toto and the others then joined Bolad Temür.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ulugh Qada'i alone led the Dada troops back to the capital, and Fang Toto and the others then followed Bolad Temür.

sentences.zh: 皇太子憾太平忤己，以中書左丞成遵、參知政事趙中皆太平所用，使監察御史誣成遵、趙中以贓罪，杖殺之。

translations.literal: The heir apparent resented Taiping for opposing him; because left vice director Cheng Zun and associate chief minister Zhao Zhong had both been men Taiping employed, he had investigating censors falsely accuse Cheng Zun and Zhao Zhong of corruption and had them beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent resented Taiping for opposing him; because left vice director Cheng Zun and associate chief minister Zhao Zhong had both been men employed by Taiping, he had investigating censors falsely accuse Cheng Zun and Zhao Zhong of corruption and had them beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 是歲以後，因上都宮闕盡廢，大駕不復時巡。

translations.literal: From this year onward, because the palace halls at Shangdu were wholly ruined, the imperial carriage no longer made its regular tours.
translations.idiomatic: From this year onward, because the palace halls at Shangdu were wholly ruined, the emperor no longer made his regular seasonal tours.

sentences.zh: 陳友諒以江州為都，迎偽主徐壽輝居之，自稱漢王。

translations.literal: Chen Youliang made Jiangzhou his capital, received the false ruler Xu Shouhui to dwell there, and styled himself King of Han.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Youliang made Jiangzhou his capital, received the false ruler Xu Shouhui to dwell there, and styled himself King of Han.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月己丑朔，察罕帖木兒請以鞏縣改立軍州萬戶府，招民屯種，從之。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, spring, first month, jichou new moon; Chaghan Temür requested that Gong County be converted into a military prefecture and commander-of-ten-thousand office and that people be recruited to settle and farm; the proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on the new moon of jichou in the first month of spring, Chaghan Temür requested that Gong County be converted into a military prefecture and commander-of-ten-thousand office and that people be recruited to settle and farm; the proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫老的沙、御史中丞咬住奏：「今後各處從宜行事官員，毋得陰挾私仇，明為舉索，輒將風憲官吏擅自遷除，侵擾行事，沮壞臺綱。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Laodsha and vice censor-in-chief Yaqut memorialized, saying: "Henceforth officials throughout the realm who act with discretionary authority must not secretly harbor private grudges and openly press demands, then on their own authority transfer surveillance and rectification officials, interfere with their duties, and undermine the censorate's authority.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Laodsha and vice censor-in-chief Yaqut memorialized, saying: "Henceforth officials throughout the realm who act with discretionary authority must not secretly harbor private grudges and openly press demands, then on their own authority transfer surveillance and rectification officials, interfere with their duties, and undermine the censorate's authority.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大寧路陷。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Daning Circuit fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Daning circuit fell.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以危素為參知政事。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Wei Su was made associate chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Wei Su was appointed associate chief minister.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，會試舉人，知貢舉平章政事八都麻失裏、同知貢舉翰林學士承旨李好文、禮部尚書許從宗、考試官國子祭酒張翥、同考官太常博士傅亨等奏：「舊例，各處鄉試舉人，三年一次，取三百名，會試取一百名。

translations.literal: On yimao day, candidates for the metropolitan examination; Badumashi, chief minister and director of the examination, Li Haowen, Hanlin academician-expositor-in-chief and associate director of the examination, Xu Congzong, minister of rites, Zhang Zhu, director of the Imperial University and examiner, Fu Heng, grand master of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and associate examiner, and others memorialized, saying: "By former practice, provincial examination candidates from each place, once every three years, numbered three hundred admitted, and the metropolitan examination admitted one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, candidates for the metropolitan examination; Badumashi, chief minister and director of the examination, Li Haowen, Hanlin academician-expositor-in-chief and associate director of the examination, Xu Congzong, minister of rites, Zhang Zhu, director of the Imperial University and examiner, Fu Heng, grand master of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and associate examiner, and others memorialized, saying: "By former practice, provincial examination candidates from each place, once every three years, numbered three hundred admitted, and the metropolitan examination admitted one hundred.

sentences.zh: 今歲鄉試所取，比前數少，止有八十八名，會試三分內取一分，合取三十名，如於三十名外，添取五名為宜。

translations.literal: This year's provincial examination produced fewer than before, only eighty-eight names; for the metropolitan examination one part in three should be taken, making thirty in all; it would be appropriate to add five beyond those thirty."
translations.idiomatic: This year's provincial examination produced fewer than before, only eighty-eight names; for the metropolitan examination one part in three should be taken, making thirty in all; it would be appropriate to add five beyond those thirty."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，五色雲見移時。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, five-colored clouds appeared for a considerable time.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, five-colored clouds appeared for a considerable time.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午朔，左丞相太平罷為太保，守上都。

translations.literal: Second month, wuwu new moon; left chief minister Taiping was dismissed and made grand preceptor, to remain at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon of wuwu, left chief minister Taiping was dismissed and made grand preceptor, with orders to remain at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子朔，田豐陷保定路。

translations.literal: Third month, wuzi new moon; Tian Feng captured Baoding Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of wuzi, Tian Feng captured Baoding circuit.

sentences.zh: 彗星見東方。

translations.literal: A comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 甲午，廷試進士三十五人，賜買住、魏元禮進士及第，其餘出身有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the palace examination of thirty-five jinshi was held; Maizhu and Wei Yuanli were granted jinshi of the highest rank, and the rest received degrees in descending order.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, thirty-five jinshi underwent the palace examination; Maizhu and Wei Yuanli were granted jinshi of the highest rank, and the rest received degrees in descending order.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，冀寧路陷。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Jining Circuit fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Jining circuit fell.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以搠思監為中書右丞相。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Suosijian was made right chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Suosijian was appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，命大司農司都事樂元臣招諭田豐，至其軍，為豐所害。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengshen day; Le Yuanchen, administrative director of the Grand Secretariat for Agriculture, was ordered to go and persuade Tian Feng; when he reached Feng's camp, Feng had him killed.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the gengshen day of the fourth month, Le Yuanchen, administrative director of the grand secretariat for agriculture, was ordered to go and persuade Tian Feng; when he reached Feng's camp, Feng had him killed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯明堂。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Bright Hall constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛未，僉行樞密院事張居敬復興中州。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Zhang Jujing, acting commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, recovered Zhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Zhang Jujing, acting commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, recovered Zhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太陰犯東咸。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Salty constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Salty constellation.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dinghai new moon; there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of dinghai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 雨雹。

translations.literal: Hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Hail fell.

sentences.zh: 陳友諒殺其偽主徐壽輝於太平路，遂稱皇帝，國號大漢，改元大義，已而回駐於江州。

translations.literal: Chen Youliang killed his false ruler Xu Shouhui at Taiping Circuit, then styled himself emperor, named his state Great Han, changed the era name to Dayi, and afterward returned to encamp at Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Youliang killed his false ruler Xu Shouhui at Taiping circuit, then styled himself emperor, named his state Great Han, changed the era name to Dayi, and afterward returned to encamp at Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，陳友諒遣羅忠顯陷辰州。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Chen Youliang dispatched Luo Zhongxian, who captured Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Chen Youliang dispatched Luo Zhongxian, who captured Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以絆住馬為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Banzhuma was made chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Banzhuma was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the moon transgressed the Establishment Stars constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the moon transgressed the Establishment Stars constellation.

sentences.zh: 是月，張士誠海運糧十一萬石至京師。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Shicheng's sea-transported grain, one hundred ten thousand shi, reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month, one hundred ten thousand shi of Zhang Shicheng's sea-transported grain reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 閏月己未，以太尉也先帖木兒知經筵事，以甘肅行省左丞相阿吉剌為太尉。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, jiwei day; Grand Commander Yesun Temür was made director of the Classics Colloquium; Ajila, left chief minister of the Gansu Branch Secretariat, was made grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the jiwei day, Grand Commander Yesun Temür was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium, and Ajila, left chief minister of the Gansu branch secretariat, was appointed grand commander.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，流星大如桃。

translations.literal: On yihai day, a meteor as large as a peach appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, a meteor as large as a peach appeared.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，命孛羅帖木兒部將方脫脫守禦嵐、興、保德州等處。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jichou day; Fang Toto, a general under Bolad Temür, was ordered to defend Lan, Xing, Baode Prefecture, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou day, Fang Toto, a general under Bolad Temür, was ordered to defend Lan, Xing, Baode Prefecture, and other places.

sentences.zh: 詔：「今後察罕帖木兒與孛羅帖木兒部將，毋得互相越境，侵犯所守信地，因而仇殺，方脫脫不得出嵐、興州境界，察罕帖木兒亦不得侵其地。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Henceforth Chaghan Temür and the generals under Bolad Temür must not cross one another's borders, violate the territories each holds in trust, and thereby kill one another in feud; Fang Toto must not go beyond the boundaries of Lan and Xing prefectures, and Chaghan Temür likewise must not encroach upon their lands.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Henceforth Chaghan Temür and the generals under Bolad Temür must not cross one another's borders, violate the territories each holds in trust, and thereby kill one another in feud; Fang Toto must not go beyond the boundaries of Lan and Xing prefectures, and Chaghan Temür likewise must not encroach upon their lands.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，太白犯井宿。

translations.literal: " On guisi day, Venus transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Venus transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the moon transgressed the Establishment Stars constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the moon transgressed the Establishment Stars constellation.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取信州路。

translations.literal: That month, Ming forces captured Xinzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Ming forces captured Xinzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，命遼陽行省參知政事張居敬討義州賊。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinyou day; Zhang Jujing, associate chief minister of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, was ordered to suppress the bandits of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the xinyou day of the seventh month, Zhang Jujing, associate chief minister of the Liaoyang branch secretariat, was ordered to suppress the bandits of Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒敗賊王士誠於臺州。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür defeated the bandit Wang Shicheng at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür defeated the rebel Wang Shicheng at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔孛羅帖木兒總領達達、漢兒軍馬，為總兵官，仍便宜行事。

translations.literal: On yihai day, an edict ordered Bolad Temür to take overall command of Dada and Han troops and horses as overall military commander, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, an edict ordered Bolad Temür to take overall command of Dada and Han troops and horses as overall military commander, with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，命孛羅帖木兒守石嶺關以北，察罕帖木兒守石嶺關以南。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day; Bolad Temür was ordered to defend north of Shiling Pass, and Chaghan Temür was ordered to defend south of Shiling Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day, Bolad Temür was ordered to defend north of Shiling Pass and Chaghan Temür was ordered to defend south of Shiling Pass.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，加封福建鎮閩王為護國英仁武烈忠正福德鎮閩尊王。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the Prince Who Guards Min of Fujian was further ennobled as the Honored Prince Who Guards Min, Protector of the State, Heroic, Benevolent, Martial, Fierce, Loyal, Upright, Fortunate, and Virtuous.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the Prince Who Guards Min of Fujian was further ennobled as the Honored Prince Who Guards Min, Protector of the State, Heroic, Benevolent, Martial, Fierce, Loyal, Upright, Fortunate, and Virtuous.

sentences.zh: 乙未，永平路陷。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Yongping Circuit fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Yongping circuit fell.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，填星犯太微。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Saturn transgressed the Supreme Palace constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Saturn transgressed the Supreme Palace constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the moon transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸處所在權攝官員，專務漁獵百姓，今後非朝廷允許，不得之任。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Acting officials throughout the realm who devote themselves solely to preying upon the people—henceforth, unless the court grants permission, they are not to take up their posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Acting officials throughout the realm who devote themselves solely to preying upon the people—henceforth, unless the court grants permission, they are not to take up their posts.

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，詔江浙行省左丞相達識帖睦邇加太尉兼知江浙行樞密院事，提調行宣政院事，便宜行事。

translations.literal: " On gengxu day, an edict made Dashi Timur, left chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, grand commander, concurrently commissioner of the Jiangzhe Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, with overall supervision of the Branch Court for the Spread of Governance and discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, an edict made Dashi Timur, left chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, grand commander, concurrently commissioner of the Jiangzhe branch bureau of military affairs, with overall supervision of the branch court for the spread of governance and discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯朔，詔遣參知政事也先不花往諭孛羅帖木兒、察罕帖木兒，令講和。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yimao new moon; an edict dispatched Yesun Buqa, associate chief minister, to go and instruct Bolad Temür and Chaghan Temür to make peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of yimao, an edict dispatched Yesun Buqa, associate chief minister, to instruct Bolad Temür and Chaghan Temür to make peace.

sentences.zh: 時孛羅帖木兒調兵自石嶺關直抵冀寧，圍其城三日，復退屯交城。

translations.literal: At the time Bolad Temür mobilized troops from Shiling Pass straight to Jining, besieged the city for three days, then withdrew and encamped at Jiaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Bolad Temür mobilized troops from Shiling Pass straight to Jining, besieged the city for three days, then withdrew and encamped at Jiaocheng.

sentences.zh: 察罕帖木兒調參政閻奉先引兵與戰，已而各於石嶺關南北守禦。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temür mobilized associate chief minister Yan Fengxian to lead troops and give battle; before long each held the defense north and south of Shiling Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temür mobilized associate chief minister Yan Fengxian to lead troops and give battle; before long each held the defense north and south of Shiling Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賊陷孟州，又陷趙州，攻真定路。

translations.literal: On renxu day, bandits captured Mengzhou, then captured Zhaozhou, and attacked Zhending Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, rebels captured Meng Prefecture, then captured Zhao Prefecture, and attacked Zhending circuit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賊復犯上都，右丞忙哥帖木兒引兵擊之，敗績。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, bandits again invaded Shangdu; right vice director Mangq Temür led troops to attack them and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, rebels again invaded Shangdu; right vice director Mangq Temür led troops to attack them and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申朔，甘露降於國子監大成殿前柏木。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiashen new moon; sweet dew fell upon the cypress before the Hall of Great Completion in the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the new moon of jiashen in the tenth month, sweet dew fell upon the cypress before the Hall of Great Completion in the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 以張良弼為湖廣行省參知政事，討南陽、襄樊。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangyu was made associate chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat to suppress Nanyang and Xiang-Fan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangyu was appointed associate chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat to suppress Nanyang and Xiang-Fan.

sentences.zh: 詔孛羅帖木兒守冀寧，孛羅帖木兒遣保保、殷興祖、高脫因倍道趨冀寧，守者不納。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Bolad Temür to hold Jining; Bolad Temür dispatched Baobao, Yin Xingzu, and Gao Toqyin by forced march toward Jining, but the defenders would not admit them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Bolad Temür to hold Jining; Bolad Temür dispatched Baobao, Yin Xingzu, and Gao Toqyin by forced march toward Jining, but the defenders would not admit them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命叠兒必失為太尉，守衛大斡耳朵思。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Tierbish was made grand commander to guard the Great Orda.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Tierbish was appointed grand commander to guard the Great Orda.

sentences.zh: 戊子，熒惑犯井宿。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Mars transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Mars transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 己亥，察罕帖木兒遣陳秉直、瑣住等，以兵攻孛羅帖木兒之軍於冀寧，與孛羅帖木兒部將脫列伯戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Chaghan Temür dispatched Chen Bingzhi, Suozhu, and others with troops to attack Bolad Temür's army at Jining; they fought Bolad Temür's general Tolui Bar and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Chaghan Temür dispatched Chen Bingzhi, Suozhu, and others with troops to attack Bolad Temür's army at Jining; they fought Bolad Temür's general Tolui Bar and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 時帝有旨以冀寧畀孛羅帖木兒，察罕帖木兒以為用兵數年，惟藉冀、晉以給其軍，而致盛強，茍奉旨與之，則彼得以足其兵食，乃托言用師汴梁，尋渡河就屯澤、潞拒之，調延安軍交戰於東勝州等處，再遣八不沙以兵援之。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor had ordered that Jining be given to Bolad Temür; Chaghan Temür held that after years of campaigning he had relied solely on Ji and Jin to supply his army and had thereby grown powerful—if he obeyed the order and yielded it, the other would be able to fill his army's provisions; he therefore pleaded that he was deploying troops to Bianliang, then crossed the river and encamped at Ze and Lu to resist him, and mobilized the Yan'an army to fight at Dongsheng Prefecture and elsewhere, dispatching Babusha again with troops to support him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor had ordered that Jining be given to Bolad Temür; Chaghan Temür held that after years of campaigning he had relied solely on Ji and Jin to supply his army and had thereby grown powerful—if he obeyed the order and yielded it, Bolad Temür would be able to fill his army's provisions; he therefore pleaded that he was deploying troops to Bianliang, then crossed the river and encamped at Ze and Lu to resist him, mobilized the Yan'an army to fight at Dongsheng prefecture and elsewhere, and dispatched Babusha again with troops to support him.

sentences.zh: 八不沙謂彼軍奉旨而來，我何敢抗王命，察罕帖木兒怒，殺之。

translations.literal: Babusha said, "Their army comes by imperial order—how dare I resist the king's command?" Chaghan Temür in anger killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Babusha said, "Their army comes by imperial order—how dare I resist the king's command?" Chaghan Temür in anger had him killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅朔，黃河清，凡三日。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiayin new moon; the Yellow River ran clear—for three days in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon of jiayin, the Yellow River ran clear for three days in all.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒以兵侵汾州，察罕帖木兒以兵拒之。

translations.literal: Bolad Temür led troops to invade Fen Prefecture; Chaghan Temür led troops to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: Bolad Temür led troops to invade Fen prefecture; Chaghan Temür led troops to resist him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賊犯易州。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, bandits attacked Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, rebels attacked Yi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，詔：「太廟、影堂祭祀，乃子孫報本重事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingxu day; an edict stated: "Sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the spirit hall are weighty matters by which descendants repay their root.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingxu day, an edict stated: "Sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the spirit hall are weighty matters by which descendants repay their root.

sentences.zh: 近兵興歲歉，品物不能豐備，累朝四祭，減為春秋二祭，今宜復四祭。

translations.literal: In recent years warfare has arisen and harvests have failed, so offerings could not be abundantly prepared; the four sacrifices of successive reigns were reduced to two sacrifices in spring and autumn—now the four sacrifices should be restored."
translations.idiomatic: In recent years warfare has arisen and harvests have failed, so offerings could not be abundantly prepared; the four sacrifices of successive reigns were reduced to two sacrifices in spring and autumn—now the four sacrifices should be restored."

sentences.zh: 」後竟不行。

translations.literal: " In the end it was never carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the end it was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廣平路陷。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Guangping Circuit fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Guangping circuit fell.

sentences.zh: 是歲，陽翟王阿魯輝帖木兒擁兵數十萬，屯於木兒古徹兀之地，將犯京畿，使來言曰：「祖宗以天下付汝，汝已失其太半；

translations.literal: That year, Prince Yangdi Arugh Temür held several hundred thousand troops encamped at Mürgüchü; he was about to invade the capital region and sent a messenger saying, "The ancestors entrusted the realm to you, and you have already lost more than half of it;
translations.idiomatic: That year, Prince Yangdi Arugh Temür held several hundred thousand troops encamped at Mürgüchü; he was about to invade the capital region and sent a messenger saying, "The ancestors entrusted the realm to you, and you have already lost more than half of it;

sentences.zh: 若以國璽付我，我當自為之。

translations.literal: if you give me the imperial seal, I shall take charge myself."
translations.idiomatic: if you give me the imperial seal, I shall take charge myself."

sentences.zh: 」帝遣報之曰：「天命有在，汝欲為則為之。

translations.literal: " The emperor sent back word: "Heaven's mandate has its place—if you wish to act, then act.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent back word: "Heaven's mandate has its place—if you wish to act, then act.

sentences.zh: 」命知樞密院事禿堅帖木兒等將兵擊之，不克，軍士皆潰，禿堅帖木兒走上都。

translations.literal: " Toghan Temür, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and others were ordered to lead troops against him; they failed, the soldiers all scattered, and Toghan Temür fled to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Toghan Temür, commissioner of the bureau of military affairs, and others were ordered to lead troops against him; they failed, the soldiers all scattered, and Toghan Temür fled to Shangdu.
